title: 真实产品电商主图
promptCN: 以我上传的[产品素材]为唯一产品来源，制作一张[1080×1080或1080×1440]电商主图。完整保留产品的颜色、尺寸比例、结构、标识和材质，不拉伸、不压扁、不凭空增加部件。产品作为视觉中心，背景使用[背景风格]，以[主卖点]建立信息层级。文字严格使用：[标题]、[副标题]、[参数]。为标题预留清晰安全区，避免文字遮挡产品；无法准确呈现的文字留空，供后期排版。光影与产品接触面自然，整体清爽，手机上可辨读。
promptEN: Using my uploaded [product asset] as the only product source, create a [1080×1080 or 1080×1440] e-commerce main image. Preserve color, proportions, structure, logos and material; do not stretch, flatten or invent parts. Make the product the focal point against [background style], prioritizing [main benefit]. Use only this text: [headline], [subtitle], [specifications]. Reserve readable text space without covering the product. Leave text blank if it cannot be rendered accurately. Keep contact shadows natural and the image readable on a phone.

title: 电商详情页信息架构
promptCN: 你是一名电商视觉策划。根据[产品资料]，为[目标用户]设计宽度1080px的移动端详情页方案。按首屏主张、核心卖点、使用场景、结构细节、规格参数、购买答疑安排模块。每个模块给出标题、30字以内文案、建议素材、版式及预计高度。所有性能描述仅使用资料中的可验证信息；缺失数据标注待补充。文字具体，避免空泛的高端、领先和绝对化承诺。输出一份可直接交给设计师的制作清单。
promptEN: Act as an e-commerce visual planner. Based on [product information], plan a 1080px-wide mobile detail page for [target customer]. Structure it as first-screen proposition, core benefits, use cases, construction details, specifications and purchase FAQ. For each module give a headline, short copy, asset needs, layout and estimated height. Use only verifiable claims from the supplied material, mark missing data, and avoid unsupported superlatives. Output a designer-ready production list.

title: 白底商品精修
promptCN: 精修上传的[产品照片]，输出干净的纯白背景商品图，比例[1:1]。保持真实外观、颜色、商标、边缘形状和各部件位置，修复灰尘与拍摄瑕疵，保留真实材质纹理。让产品完整出现在画面中，四周留安全边距，补充柔和自然的接触阴影。不增加配件、不改变结构、不生成新的商品。
promptEN: Retouch my uploaded [product photo] into a clean pure-white product image in [1:1] format. Preserve appearance, color, logo, edges and component positions. Remove dust and photographic defects while keeping material texture. Show the entire product with safe margins and a soft contact shadow. Do not add accessories, change its structure or generate a different product.

title: 科技硬件展示背景
promptCN: 生成一张用于展示[内存/显卡/主板]的[9:16]背景，只生成背景，不生成产品。主题为[冷蓝科技/黑红极简/冰晶/熔岩黑曜石]。在画面中下部预留宽阔、干净的产品展示区域，设置简洁底座，主光来自[方向]，轮廓光颜色为[颜色]。上方预留标题区域，避免文字、品牌、复杂装饰和密集纹理。画面高级、克制，前后景层次清晰。
promptEN: Generate a [9:16] background for displaying [memory / graphics card / motherboard]. Generate only the background, not the product. Theme: [cool blue technology / minimal black and red / ice crystal / lava and obsidian]. Leave a wide clean display area in the lower center, with a simple pedestal, light from [direction] and [color] rim lighting. Reserve headline space above. Avoid text, logos, dense textures and complicated props. Keep the depth clear and composition restrained.

title: 同款主图的方形与竖版
promptCN: 以上传的[主图]和[产品素材]为参考，分别输出1080×1080和1080×1440的电商主图布局方案。保持同一视觉风格、文字内容、品牌识别和卖点顺序；根据比例重新分配标题、产品和参数的位置，不直接拉伸或机械裁切。用表格列出每版的元素、位置百分比、宽高、对齐方式和留白。产品比例始终以真实素材为准，指出需要人工校对的文字与参数。
tags: 同款主图的方形与竖版
promptEN: Using [reference main image] and [product assets], plan both 1080×1080 and 1080×1440 e-commerce layouts. Preserve visual style, copy, brand recognition and benefit order. Reposition the headline, product and specifications to suit each aspect ratio rather than stretching or mechanically cropping. In a table list each element, percentage position, dimensions, alignment and spacing. Keep product proportions authentic and mark text and specifications needing manual checking.

title: 自然光生活场景
promptCN: 以我上传的[产品]为主体，放入[生活场景]中。保持产品真实颜色、形状、比例和材质，镜头采用[俯拍/平视/近景]，自然光从侧面进入，环境色为[配色]，道具仅使用[允许的道具]，且不能遮挡主要结构。产品占画面[比例]，留出标题空间，光影与透视一致。避免漂浮、错误反射、变形和多余产品。
promptEN: Place my uploaded [product] in [lifestyle scene], preserving authentic color, shape, proportions and material. Use an [overhead / eye-level / close-up] view, side natural light, [palette] and only [allowed props]. Do not obscure important product structure. The product occupies [percentage] of the frame with room for a headline. Keep light, shadows and perspective consistent. Avoid floating objects, incorrect reflections, distortion and additional products.

title: 主图视觉校对清单
promptCN: 检查[参考图]与[成品图]的差异，按整体结构、产品比例、文字内容、参数数量、字体、间距、裁切、颜色、阴影依次比较。把问题按影响购买理解的严重程度排序，逐项指出具体位置、参考状态、当前状态和修改方式。优先检查型号、数量、规格是否完全一致；看不清的内容标记待确认，不猜测。给出修改后复查清单。
promptEN: Compare [reference image] with [finished image], checking overall structure, product proportions, copy, specification quantities, typography, spacing, cropping, color and shadows. Rank issues by their effect on purchase understanding. For each identify location, expected appearance, current appearance and correction. Prioritize exact model, quantity and specification matching. Mark illegible information as unconfirmed rather than guessing. Provide a post-correction checklist.

title: 产品卖点提炼
promptCN: 根据[产品资料]和[使用人群]，提炼5个电商卖点。每项按真实属性、用户收益、适合场景、可用证据输出。将标题控制在8字以内，配一条20字以内说明。不编造参数、不使用无依据的最高级或医疗效果。缺少的证据单独列在末尾。
promptEN: From [product information] and [target audience], extract five e-commerce benefits. For each give the authentic attribute, user benefit, use case and supporting evidence, plus a concise headline and short explanation. Do not invent specifications, unsupported superlatives or medical effects. List missing evidence separately.

title: 品牌广告海报构图
promptCN: 为[品牌]的[产品]设计一张[比例]广告海报。目标受众是[人群]，唯一传播重点为[核心信息]。视觉风格为[风格]，背景颜色[颜色]，产品以真实素材呈现并保持比例。标题为[标题]，附加文字为[文案]，只允许这些文字。给出一个主视觉焦点，避免拥挤道具，品牌和文案拥有清楚的安全区。
promptEN: Design a [ratio] advertising poster for [brand] and [product], aimed at [audience], communicating only [core message]. Style: [style]. Background: [color]. Use the actual product asset with correct proportions. Headline: [headline]. Other copy: [copy]. Allow no other text. Establish one main visual focal point, avoid crowded props, and reserve clear space for brand and copy.

title: 详情页参数检查
promptCN: 对照[原始产品资料]校对[详情页文案]。逐条检查尺寸、数量、型号、颜色、材质、适配对象和性能描述。输出问题表：位置、当前内容、资料依据、建议修改、确认状态。资料没有提供的数值不要补全；对可能引起误解的描述给出更准确表达。保留已确认正确的参数。
promptEN: Check [detail-page copy] against [original product information]. Verify dimensions, quantities, model, color, material, compatibility and performance claims. Output a table of location, current text, evidence, correction and confirmation status. Do not fill in values absent from the source. Clarify misleading claims and preserve confirmed specifications.

title: 一分钟短视频脚本
promptCN: 围绕[主题]，为[目标受众]写一段约一分钟的口播脚本。开头用一个具体问题吸引注意，正文只讲三个关键点，最后给出一个可执行建议。每句话单独一行，使用自然口语，避免长句、空泛形容词和夸张结论。事实仅依据[资料]，不确定内容明确标注。附一个15字以内标题。
promptEN: Write an approximately one-minute spoken video script about [topic] for [audience]. Open with a specific question, cover only three key points and finish with one actionable suggestion. Put each sentence on a separate line and use natural spoken language. Avoid long sentences, vague adjectives and exaggerated conclusions. Base facts only on [material], flag uncertainty, and add a short title.

title: 把长文变成清晰摘要
promptCN: 阅读[原文]，输出适合[读者]的摘要。先用一句话说明核心结论，再列出3至5个关键事实与对应依据，最后列出原文没有回答的问题。保留关键数字、日期和限定条件，不引入原文外的信息。总长度控制在[字数]字以内，区分作者观点与已证实事实。
titleEN: Turn long text into a clear summary
promptEN: Summarize [original text] for [reader]. Start with one sentence stating the core conclusion, then give three to five key facts with their supporting evidence, and finish with questions the source does not answer. Retain important numbers, dates and limitations. Add no external information. Stay within [word count] words and distinguish author opinion from established fact.

title: 品牌文案的三种语气
promptCN: 为[产品或服务]写三版文案，分别采用专业清晰、自然亲切、简洁有力的语气。受众为[人群]，发布场景为[渠道]，核心信息是[信息]。每版包含标题和不超过80字正文，明确用户能获得什么。只使用[已确认事实]，避免虚构口碑、销售数字和效果承诺。
promptEN: Write three versions of copy for [product or service]: professional and clear, friendly and natural, and concise and strong. Audience: [people]. Channel: [channel]. Key message: [message]. Each version needs a headline and a short body explaining the user benefit. Use only [confirmed facts]. Do not invent testimonials, sales figures or promises.

title: 专业邮件草稿
promptCN: 为[收件人角色]起草一封关于[事项]的邮件。目的为[希望对方采取的行动]，背景为[背景]，截止时间为[日期]。提供清楚的主题、简短开头、必要背景和明确请求，语气礼貌直接。缺失信息使用方括号占位，不编造名字、时间或承诺。
promptEN: Draft an email to [recipient role] about [matter]. Desired action: [action]. Background: [background]. Deadline: [date]. Provide a clear subject, short opening, necessary context and explicit request in a polite direct tone. Leave missing names, dates and commitments in square brackets rather than inventing them.

title: 文章结构规划
promptCN: 围绕[主题]为[目标读者]规划一篇[字数]字文章。先定义读者最需要解决的问题，再给出标题、开头切入点、3至5个章节及各章主要论点。每个论点列出所需证据和具体例子，标记尚未提供的材料。避免重复段落和与主问题无关的延展。
promptEN: Plan a [length]-word article about [topic] for [readers]. Identify the reader’s central question, then provide a title, opening angle, three to five sections and each section’s main argument. List required evidence and specific examples for every argument, marking missing material. Avoid repetition and unrelated expansion.

title: 文案去冗余与润色
promptCN: 编辑[原文]，保留原意、语气和所有已确认事实。删除重复表达、空泛套话与不必要的形容词，使用主动语态和短句。先输出完整修订稿，再列出5处最重要的修改及理由。不要引入新的观点，不改变数字与承诺。
promptEN: Edit [original text] while retaining meaning, tone and all confirmed facts. Remove repetition, filler and unnecessary adjectives; use active voice and shorter sentences. Give the complete revision followed by the five most important edits and their reasons. Do not add viewpoints or alter numbers and commitments.

title: 产品常见问题解答
promptCN: 根据[产品资料]为[用户群体]写一份FAQ。覆盖适用场景、规格、操作、维护与售后，优先回答会影响购买决定的问题。每个答案不超过100字，缺失政策或参数标记待确认，不编造保修、退款和效果。给出10组具体问答。
promptEN: Using [product information], write ten FAQ pairs for [user group]. Cover use cases, specifications, operation, maintenance and after-sales support, prioritizing purchase decisions. Keep answers brief. Mark missing policies or specifications as unconfirmed and do not invent warranty, refund or effectiveness claims.

title: 采访提纲
promptCN: 为[受访者角色]设计关于[主题]的采访提纲，目标是理解[核心问题]。按背景、具体经历、关键决定、困难与反思排序，提供12个开放式问题。避免诱导答案，每个问题附一个追问，鼓励给出事实、例子和当时的判断。
promptEN: Create an interview outline for [interviewee role] about [topic] to understand [core question]. Order twelve open-ended questions from background and specific experiences to decisions, challenges and reflection. Avoid leading questions. Add one follow-up to each, asking for facts, examples and the reasoning used at the time.

title: 社交内容日历
promptCN: 为[品牌或个人]围绕[主题]制作[周期]的内容日历。平台为[平台]，每周发布[数量]条，受众为[人群]。用表格给出日期、主题、内容角度、素材需求、标题和希望达成的目标。兼顾实用知识、真实案例与互动内容，不使用虚构事件或评论。
promptEN: Create a [period] content calendar for [brand or person] about [topic] on [platform], with [number] posts per week for [audience]. In a table give date, subject, angle, asset requirements, title and objective. Balance useful knowledge, authentic examples and audience interaction. Do not invent events or comments.

title: 中文与英文自然改写
promptCN: 将[文本]改写为适合[目标市场]读者的[语言]版本。保留数字、专有名词、语气和原有事实，调整不自然的直译表达。先输出改写稿，再解释3处关键措辞。无法确定的行业术语列出候选译法，等待确认。
promptEN: Rewrite [text] in [language] for readers in [target market]. Preserve numbers, proper names, tone and facts while correcting unnatural literal translations. Provide the rewrite and explain three key wording choices. For uncertain industry terminology, offer alternatives for confirmation.

title: 从资料生成讲稿
promptCN: 根据[资料]撰写面向[听众]的[时长]分钟演讲稿。先明确一个主要结论，以具体例子开场，正文采用问题、证据、建议的结构。每段围绕一个意思，标注自然停顿。不得虚构引语或研究，未核实的信息标记待确认。
promptEN: Using [material], write a [duration]-minute speech for [audience]. State one main conclusion, open with a concrete example and organize the body around problem, evidence and recommendation. Keep one idea per paragraph and indicate natural pauses. Do not invent quotations or studies; flag unverified claims.

title: 观点与事实分离
promptCN: 分析[文章或帖子]，区分事实陈述、推论、个人观点和宣传用语。用表格列出原文片段、类别、所需证据和表达建议。不要仅凭语气判定真假，对缺少来源的内容标记未验证，最后给出一版措辞更准确的摘要。
promptEN: Analyze [article or post], separating factual claims, inference, personal opinion and promotional language. Provide a table of passage, category, required evidence and suggested wording. Do not judge truth from tone alone. Mark unsourced claims as unverified and finish with a more precise summary.

title: 代码审查
promptCN: 审查[代码]，运行环境为[环境]，预期行为为[行为]。优先寻找真实的逻辑错误、输入边界、资源泄漏与安全问题。每个问题给出文件位置、触发条件、影响、最小修复建议和可验证示例。按严重程度排序；不要为个人风格偏好提出修改。无法运行时明确区分推断与已验证结论。
promptEN: Review [code] running in [environment] against [expected behavior]. Prioritize real logic errors, input boundaries, resource leaks and security issues. For each issue give location, trigger, impact, minimal correction and a verifiable example. Rank by severity. Do not suggest changes based only on personal style. Distinguish inferred from tested findings if execution is unavailable.

title: 定位报错根因
promptCN: 根据[错误日志]、[相关代码]、[运行环境]分析故障。先列出最可能的三种原因，并说明支持或反驳每种原因的证据。给出可逐步执行的诊断步骤，每步包含预期输出。找到根因后再提供最小补丁，不要同时改动无关代码，不要求输出密钥或敏感环境变量。
titleEN: Find the root cause of an error
promptEN: Using [error log], [relevant code] and [environment], diagnose the failure. Give the three most likely causes and evidence for or against each. Provide sequential diagnostic steps with expected outputs. Once the root cause is identified, propose the smallest patch. Avoid unrelated edits and never request secrets or sensitive environment values.

title: 响应式页面实现
promptCN: 根据[设计描述或参考]实现[页面]，技术栈为[技术栈]。保留既有依赖和组件系统，布局覆盖手机、平板和桌面；保证导航、搜索、按钮及详情操作真实可用。包含加载、空结果与错误状态，支持键盘与减少动画设置。使用语义HTML，避免横向溢出。提交完整代码并说明如何验证主要操作。
promptEN: Implement [page] from [design description or reference] using [stack]. Preserve existing dependencies and components. Support phone, tablet and desktop layouts, with working navigation, search, buttons and details. Include loading, empty and error states, keyboard operation and reduced-motion support. Use semantic HTML and prevent horizontal overflow. Provide complete code and a way to verify main interactions.

title: API 契约设计
promptCN: 为[业务场景]设计HTTP API。明确资源、请求字段、响应字段、状态码、分页、校验和错误格式，给出正常请求与失败请求示例。鉴权方式遵循[现有规则]，不要把敏感信息放入URL。列出向后兼容策略与尚未确认的业务约束。
promptEN: Design an HTTP API for [business scenario]. Define resources, request and response fields, status codes, pagination, validation and error format. Give successful and failed request examples. Follow [existing authentication rules] and do not place secrets in URLs. Describe backward compatibility and unresolved business constraints.

title: 重构而不改变行为
promptCN: 重构[代码]以改善[可读性或维护问题]。先总结当前行为、输入输出与副作用，保留公开接口和现有依赖。采用最小改动，解释每个结构调整解决了什么问题，给出必要的回归验证点。发现功能缺陷时单独指出，不默默改变逻辑。
promptEN: Refactor [code] to improve [readability or maintainability issue]. First summarize current behavior, input, output and side effects. Preserve public interfaces and dependencies. Make minimal changes, explain each structural improvement and give relevant regression checks. Identify functional defects separately rather than silently changing behavior.

title: SQL 查询检查
promptCN: 检查[SQL]是否满足[业务口径]，数据库为[数据库版本]，表结构为[结构]。关注连接基数、重复记录、NULL处理、时间边界和聚合口径。说明可能造成错误统计的输入示例，再给出修订查询与适用索引建议。未经授权不要修改生产数据。
promptEN: Check whether [SQL] meets [business definition], using [database version] and [schema]. Examine join cardinality, duplicates, NULL handling, time boundaries and aggregation definitions. Give inputs that could produce wrong totals, then a corrected query and justified index suggestions. Do not change production data without authorization.

title: 为关键行为写测试
promptCN: 为[函数或功能]制定精简测试，使用[测试框架]。围绕公开行为覆盖正常路径、边界条件和主要失败路径，避免与实现逐行对应。给出可独立运行的测试代码与必要的最少模拟。每个测试说明它能发现哪类实际缺陷。
promptEN: Create a concise test suite for [function or feature] using [test framework]. Cover public behavior through normal, boundary and important failure paths rather than mirroring implementation. Provide independently runnable tests with minimal mocking. Explain the real defect each test could catch.

title: 技术方案取舍
promptCN: 比较[方案A]与[方案B]，使用场景为[场景]，约束为[团队能力、成本、性能、时间]。以表格比较维护、扩展、迁移与失败恢复，并明确哪些判断有资料依据、哪些是估计。给出推荐及其适用条件，不引用未经验证的基准数字。
promptEN: Compare [approach A] and [approach B] for [scenario], given [team capability, budget, performance and timeline constraints]. Use a table covering maintenance, scaling, migration and recovery. Distinguish evidence from estimates. Recommend an approach with conditions, avoiding unverified benchmark numbers.

title: 性能问题诊断
promptCN: 根据[性能测量]、[代码]和[负载特征]定位瓶颈。区分CPU、内存、网络、数据库与渲染成本，先要求可复现的测量再优化。给出最小实验、预期变化和回退方案。避免没有证据的缓存或并发改造，保持功能语义。
promptEN: Diagnose bottlenecks from [measurements], [code] and [workload]. Separate CPU, memory, network, database and rendering costs. Require reproducible measurements before optimizing. Propose a minimal experiment, expected change and rollback. Avoid unsupported caching or concurrency redesign and preserve semantics.

title: README 使用指南
promptCN: 为[项目]编写README，依据[代码与配置]。包含项目用途、环境要求、安装、启动、配置、常用操作和故障排查。命令必须与现有脚本一致，使用占位值示例，不包含真实密钥。标注尚未验证的步骤，避免虚构支持功能。
promptEN: Write a README for [project] based on [code and configuration]. Include purpose, prerequisites, installation, startup, configuration, common tasks and troubleshooting. Commands must match actual scripts. Use placeholder values, never real keys. Mark unverified steps and do not invent supported features.

title: 无障碍界面检查
promptCN: 检查[页面代码]的可访问性。重点审查语义结构、控件名称、键盘操作、焦点管理、表单错误、对比度和动画降级。对每个实际问题给出影响的使用者、代码位置与具体修复。不要只提供通用清单；区分静态可判断的问题与需要浏览器验证的问题。
promptEN: Review the accessibility of [page code], focusing on semantics, control names, keyboard use, focus management, form errors, contrast and motion reduction. For each actual issue identify affected users, location and a concrete fix. Avoid a generic checklist and distinguish static findings from checks needing a browser.

title: 数据迁移方案
promptCN: 为[现有结构]迁移到[目标结构]制定方案。明确数据映射、默认值、无效记录处理、备份、验证和回滚。优先保证兼容与可恢复，给出分批执行策略及计数核对方法。对不可逆步骤单独说明，未经确认不要执行生产变更。
promptEN: Plan a migration from [current structure] to [target structure]. Define mapping, defaults, invalid-record handling, backup, verification and rollback. Prioritize compatibility and recoverability. Give a batch strategy and count checks. Identify irreversible steps separately and do not perform production changes without confirmation.

title: 会议记录变行动清单
promptCN: 根据[会议记录]整理决定与行动项。先用三句话概括会议结果，再用表格列出任务、负责人、截止时间、依赖和确认状态。未明确的负责人或日期写待确认，不自行分配。将争议、开放问题与已达成决定分开列出。
promptEN: Turn [meeting notes] into decisions and action items. Summarize the outcome in three sentences, then provide a table of task, owner, deadline, dependency and confirmation status. Mark unspecified owners or dates as unconfirmed rather than assigning them. Separate disputes and open questions from agreed decisions.

title: Excel 公式助手
promptCN: 根据[表格列定义]与[目标结果]设计适用于[Excel版本或Google Sheets]的公式。解释引用范围、空值处理与错误处理，给出可直接粘贴的公式和三组输入输出示例。保留日期与数字类型，缺少表结构时列出需要的最少信息。
promptEN: Using [column definitions] and [desired result], design a formula for [Excel version or Google Sheets]. Explain ranges, empty cells and errors. Provide a copy-ready formula and three input-output examples. Preserve date and numeric types, and request only the minimum missing structural information.

title: 一页项目周报
promptCN: 依据[本周记录]整理项目周报，面向[读者]。按本周结果、关键指标、阻碍、下周计划输出。每项结果使用可核实的具体事实，说明下一步的负责人和时间；缺失信息标记待补充。总长度控制在一页，不使用空泛的进展顺利。
promptEN: Create a one-page weekly project report from [weekly records] for [reader]. Cover results, key metrics, blockers and next week’s plan. Use verifiable specifics, including owners and times for next actions. Mark missing information and avoid vague statements such as progress is going well.

title: 工作优先级梳理
promptCN: 整理[任务清单]，约束为[截止时间、资源、依赖]。按影响、紧急程度和阻塞关系排序，给出今天必须做、可以安排、需要确认的任务。每项说明排序理由与预估工作量，不虚构外部期限。输出一份现实可执行的日程。
promptEN: Prioritize [task list] given [deadlines, resources and dependencies]. Rank by impact, urgency and blocking relationships. Separate tasks to do today, schedule later and clarify first. Explain each ranking and estimated effort without inventing external deadlines. Give a realistic daily schedule.

title: 数据表清洗方案
promptCN: 为[数据样例]制定清洗规则，目标为[分析用途]。检查重复、空值、类型、单位、异常值和编码。先说明问题与影响，再提供清洗步骤、保留原始数据的方法和校验指标。不随意删除异常记录，区分可修复项与需人工确认项。
promptEN: Create cleaning rules for [data sample] to support [analysis purpose]. Check duplicates, missing values, types, units, outliers and encoding. Explain problems and impact, then provide steps, preservation of raw data and verification metrics. Do not delete outliers casually; distinguish automatic fixes from manual review.

title: 商务沟通更清楚
promptCN: 将[消息草稿]改写为简洁、礼貌的工作沟通。保留事实、责任边界和原有承诺，清楚表达背景、请求与期望时间。输出正式版和日常版各一份；缺失的日期或对象保留占位，不扩大请求或增加未经确认的承诺。
promptEN: Rewrite [message draft] into concise polite business communication. Preserve facts, responsibility boundaries and commitments. Clearly state context, request and expected timing. Give a formal and a conversational version. Leave missing dates or recipients as placeholders and do not expand requests or commitments.

title: 报告转演示提纲
promptCN: 把[报告]转成[页数]页演示提纲，受众为[受众]，目标为[目标]。每页给出结论式标题、3个以内要点、推荐图表和需要的原始数据。只使用报告已有结论，标记缺少证据的地方。安排开场、核心论证和明确的下一步。
promptEN: Turn [report] into a [slide count]-slide outline for [audience] to achieve [goal]. For each slide give a conclusion-led title, no more than three points, recommended chart and required source data. Use only existing report conclusions and flag missing evidence. Include an opening, core argument and explicit next step.

title: 研究资料归纳
promptCN: 依据[资料集合]围绕[问题]整理研究笔记。用表格列出来源、核心发现、适用条件、相互矛盾的结论和未解决问题。保留来源对应关系，不将推测写成事实。最后说明还需要什么信息才能做出判断。
promptEN: Organize [research materials] around [question]. In a table give source, finding, applicability, conflicting conclusions and unresolved questions. Maintain source links and do not present speculation as fact. Explain what further information is needed for a decision.

title: 流程 SOP 草稿
promptCN: 根据[现有流程描述]撰写供[岗位]使用的SOP。包含适用范围、前置条件、操作步骤、检查点、异常处理和完成标准。每步只描述一个可执行动作，明确依赖与交接对象。缺失的权限、工具或规则标记待确认。
promptEN: Write an SOP for [role] from [current process description]. Include scope, prerequisites, steps, checkpoints, exception handling and completion criteria. Each step should contain one actionable instruction with dependencies and handoff owner. Mark missing permissions, tools or rules as unconfirmed.

title: 项目风险梳理
promptCN: 根据[项目方案]识别具体风险。用表格列出触发条件、概率依据、影响、预防措施、应对措施与责任人。区分已出现的问题和未来风险，不使用没有依据的概率数字。给出优先处理的前三项及原因。
promptEN: Identify specific risks in [project plan]. In a table give trigger, evidence for likelihood, impact, prevention, response and owner. Separate current problems from future risks and avoid unsupported probability numbers. Identify the top three priorities and explain why.

title: 跨部门需求整理
promptCN: 把[零散需求]整理为一份可评审的需求文档。明确问题、目标用户、核心流程、必要功能、验收条件与未决问题。识别冲突和重复，避免自动扩大范围。每项需求附来源与可观察的成功标准。
promptEN: Turn [scattered requirements] into a reviewable requirements document. Define problem, users, core flow, necessary features, acceptance criteria and open questions. Identify conflict and duplication without automatically expanding scope. Attach a source and observable success criterion to each requirement.

title: 工作复盘
promptCN: 根据[项目过程与结果]写一份复盘。以预期目标、实际结果、关键差异、证据、原因和下一步实验为结构。区分个人判断与事实，不把结果差直接等同于人员问题。提出三项具体改进，每项包含负责人、完成时间和检查方法。
promptEN: Write a retrospective from [project process and results], covering goals, actual outcome, main differences, evidence, causes and next experiments. Distinguish judgment from fact and do not equate poor results with individual blame. Propose three concrete improvements with owner, due date and verification method.

title: 白色产品白底主图
promptEN: Use [product reference] to make a square ecommerce hero of the [white product], intended for a 1080×1080 canvas. Preserve the actual aspect ratio, corner curves, connector locations, surface texture and branding. Limit changes to background cleanup, dust and unwanted color casts. Center the complete item at roughly three quarters of the frame with equal safe margins. Soft neutral side lighting should reveal subtle tonal edges and a believable contact shadow against clean white. Keep detail in the white shell; retain distinct transparent and metallic materials. Include only the original item and existing markings. Inspect the silhouette, logo and connectors against the source before delivery.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 以[产品原图]中的[白色产品]为唯一商品主体，制作电商白底主图，目标画布为1080×1080方形。完整保留实物的长宽比例、边角弧度、接口位置、表面纹理和品牌标识；仅清理背景、灰尘及拍摄杂色。主体居中，占画面约四分之三，四周留出相等安全边距，不裁掉任何突出零件。使用偏中性的柔和侧光，在白色外壳边缘留下细微灰阶与真实接触阴影，背景保持干净纯白，白色部分仍有层次，不被提亮成无轮廓色块。保留透明件和金属件各自的材质差别，不把白色改成银色。画面只出现原有商品，不添加配件、文字、促销角标或装饰。输出前检查轮廓、标识和接口与参考一致。

title: 内存条比例锁定主视觉
promptEN: Create a 3:4 ecommerce hero for [brand/model] using [RAM reference]. Lock the module's actual length, height and thickness, heatsink outline, light-bar extent, gold contacts, notch, screws and printed markings. Keep the entire module in the lower half at its existing perspective and leave the upper third available for later typography. Use a graphite background with a faint cool gradient, narrow soft rim light and restrained frontal fill. If the reference light bar is off, keep it off; if illuminated, retain its color and physical extent. Change the environment and lighting only. Keep the contacts visible and check every structural feature against the reference.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 使用[内存条原图]制作[品牌/型号]的竖版电商主视觉，目标比例3:4，商品保持参考照片中的真实长度、厚度和高度。锁定散热马甲轮廓、灯条范围、金手指数量与朝向、螺丝、缺口和印刷标记，不能把内存条拉宽、缩短或变成其他硬件。将完整内存条放在画面下半部，略带原图已有的透视，上方留约三分之一空间供后期排版。背景为深石墨灰与微弱冷色渐变，侧后方窄条柔光勾勒边缘，正面低强度补光显示材质。若参考未点亮灯条，保持熄灭；若已点亮，沿用原颜色，不虚构额外发光结构。只调整环境、光线与背景，避免遮挡金手指。画面不生成新文案，逐项核对结构与原图。

title: 内存散热马甲材质近景
promptEN: Make a 1080-square ecommerce detail crop from [high-resolution RAM photo], showing the genuine [brushed aluminum/sandblasted metal] finish at [specified visible area]. Crop only documented geometry; do not reconstruct hidden circuitry. Keep a logo or structural boundary in view to establish location. Broad grazing light from upper left and restrained reflected fill should reveal the real grain direction and shallow engraved lines. Remove loose dust while keeping the material texture. Exclude invented slots, sparks, droplets and exaggerated scratches. Leave a small lower-right area for a later process caption. Generate no text or performance claims; confirm the resulting crop still makes structural sense.

title: 实物尺寸与比例说明图
promptEN: Build a square dimensions card from [product photo] and verified [length × width × height]. Keep the complete product slightly below center with its original geometry and perspective, on pale gray under even soft light. Place three thin dimension guides outside the silhouette. Use only the supplied labels “[length]”, “[width]” and “[height]” in dark gray sans serif, next to the relevant direction. Never infer measurements from perspective. Put any dimension that cannot be shown honestly in a separate specification row instead of a misleading arrow. Leave missing values blank and add no weights, compatibility or certifications. Verify units, decimal points, numbers and preserved hardware details.

promptCN: 以[商品原图]及已核对的[长×宽×高尺寸]为依据，设计1080×1080尺寸说明图。完整商品置于中央偏下，保持原图比例与透视，使用浅灰背景和均匀柔光，边缘清晰而不过度锐化。在商品外侧设置三条简洁尺寸引导线，线条不穿过主体，不利用透视长度推算实测尺寸。文字仅使用已提供的“[长度]”“[宽度]”“[高度]”，统一深灰无衬线字体，标注紧邻对应方向且不重叠。若某个维度在当前视角不可辨认，改为下方独立规格列，不绘制误导性箭头。未提供的数据留空，不添加重量、兼容性或认证。保持所有接口、螺孔和品牌标记不变，最终逐字核对单位、小数点与数值，必要时留白供人工排字。

title: 中文促销信息方形卡
promptEN: Combine [product photo] with approved [promotion details] in a 1080-square card for [audience]. Place the complete product in the right 55 percent, preserving real proportions. Use a restrained [brand color] gradient and a flat, readable text area on the left. Render exactly “[Chinese headline]”, “[Chinese subheading]” and “[verified price]” with clear size hierarchy and legible Chinese sans serif. Do not translate, substitute characters or add punctuation. Maintain safe margins, match the source light direction and add a subtle contact shadow. Include a deadline only if supplied. Invent no former price, discount, stock level or specifications. If lettering cannot be reproduced accurately, reserve that area for manual typesetting.

promptCN: 将[商品照片]与已审核的[活动信息]结合成1080×1080促销卡，面向[目标顾客]。商品置于右侧约百分之五十五区域，保持完整轮廓与真实比例，背景采用[品牌主色]的低对比渐变，左侧文字区保持简洁平整。主标题只写“[中文标题]”，副标题只写“[中文副标题]”，活动价格只写“[已核实价格]”，三者按大小建立清楚层级，使用端正、可读的中文无衬线字，不变字、不翻译、不添加感叹号。边缘保留充足安全距离。柔和顶光与原照片方向一致，商品下方增加轻微接触阴影，避免悬浮。活动期限若未提供则不出现，不虚构原价、折扣、库存或性能。先保证商品一致性与文案准确，无法稳定生成的字保留空位，供后期排版。

title: 包装与配件核对平铺
promptEN: Create a 3:4 overhead unboxing inventory from [product photos] and the verified [box contents list]. Show only items genuinely included. Put the main product centrally, its packaging above and accessories arranged by type below, with clear separation and visible connectors. Preserve the relative physical sizes; do not enlarge accessories to fill gaps. Use warm pale-gray seamless paper and broad soft light from the left, with consistent shadows. Keep existing package printing and do not redesign it. Add no decorative gifts, tools or cables. If an included item has no usable reference, leave space and note the missing reference in accompanying output rather than inventing it. Add no new lettering to the image.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 参考[商品照片]和[包装内含物清单]，制作3:4竖版开箱清单图，只展示清单中确实随包装附带的物品。以正上方俯拍方式，将主商品放在画面中央，包装盒置于上方，配件按类别整齐放在下方，彼此留出清楚间距，不遮住接口或说明标签。保持不同物品之间的真实大小关系，不能为了填满空间放大配件或缩小主商品。背景为浅暖灰无缝纸，宽大柔光从左侧照入，所有阴影朝同一方向。保留原包装上的已有文字与印刷，不设计新包装，不增加装饰性赠品、工具或电缆。未拍到的配件不凭空补全，改留空并在输出说明中列明缺少参考。图片不叠加新文案，整体优先帮助消费者准确理解实际收到的内容。

title: 内存安装环境合成
promptEN: Image 1 is [RAM product]; image 2 is [a photographed motherboard verified compatible with this model]. Composite the module into [specified slot]. Match slot length, notch direction, vertical angle and latch position without changing the contacts. The module must seat physically rather than float above the socket. If the reference angles do not support a credible composite, show the references side by side and request another view in accompanying text. Use a 3:4 frame emphasizing the connection, with soft side light on the latches and heatsink and modest background blur. Preserve the module's proportions, actual light-bar state and existing board components. Remove unrelated desk clutter and add no invented branding or performance labels.

promptCN: 图片1为[内存条实物]，图片2为已经确认支持该型号的[主板与插槽实拍]。将图片1中的内存条合成到图片2的[指定插槽位置]，用于展示真实安装场景。先匹配插槽长度、缺口方向、垂直角度与卡扣位置，不能改变金手指结构，也不能把内存条悬在插槽上方或插入不相容接口。若两张照片角度无法支持可信合成，保持并排展示并说明需要补拍，不生成错误安装。整体采用3:4竖版，突出内存与主板接合处，柔和侧光照亮卡扣与散热马甲，周围线缆适度虚化。保留散热马甲比例和灯条实际状态，不添加虚构品牌或性能标签。清除无关桌面杂物，保持主板现有零件位置不变，最终检查插槽数量与接触关系。

title: 居家桌面使用氛围
promptEN: Place [desktop product reference] in a calm home office for a 3:4 product page. Position it in the lower-left foreground with only a closed notebook and an ordinary mug as scale references. Keep physically believable relative sizes. Use a pale wood desk, softly blurred neutral wall and window shadows, leaving the upper-right area available for copy. Window light from the left should produce matching contact shadows, color temperature and reflections. Preserve controls, ports, structure and branding. Add no screens, status lights, connection symbols or unverified functionality. Include no people or hands. Convey a credible everyday setting without text or invented specifications.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 将[产品原图]中的[桌面产品]放入真实、整洁的居家办公环境，用于3:4商品详情页。产品位于前景左下侧，旁边只放一本闭合笔记本与一个普通杯子作为尺度参照，所有物体大小关系符合实物，不把产品夸张放大。桌面为浅色木纹，背景是模糊的中性色墙面和窗边光影，上方右侧留出可排版空白。主光来自画面左侧窗户，产品与桌面的接触阴影、色温和反射应一致。保留原有结构、按键、接口和标识，只做场景合成，不添加产品没有的屏幕、指示灯或无线连接符号。不出现人物面部、手部或未经确认的使用功能。画面呈现安静、可信赖的日常使用氛围，不生成文字和虚构性能描述。

title: 核实规格分区卡
promptEN: Make a 3:4 specifications card for [model] from [product photo] and [verified specification table]. Show the complete product in the upper half, retaining its form, proportions, colors and existing labels. Reserve three aligned rows below reading exactly “[field 1]: [value 1]”, “[field 2]: [value 2]” and “[field 3]: [value 3]”. Use readable Chinese sans serif with generous spacing; wrap long model names without omission. Pale gray and small [brand color] accents should complement broad soft lighting. Use only supplied data. Leave missing values blank instead of inferring capacity, frequency, power or compatibility from appearance. Add no rankings, certification badges or test charts. Verify every number and unit, or finish lettering manually.

promptCN: 为[产品型号]制作3:4竖版规格卡，输入为[产品原图]与[已确认参数表]。上半部放置完整实物，保留形态、比例、配色和已有标签；下半部设置三行整齐的信息栏，分别承载“[参数名称1]：[数值1]”“[参数名称2]：[数值2]”“[参数名称3]：[数值3]”。使用清晰中文无衬线字，统一对齐方式，长型号允许换行但不能漏字。背景采用浅灰与[品牌色]小面积点缀，宽大柔光让白色或金属外壳保持细节。只使用参数表中的内容，缺失值以空位保留，不依据外观推断频率、容量、功率或兼容平台。不得出现比较级、认证徽章或测试图表。给文字区足够行距与边距，生成后逐字核对数字、单位与型号，必要时将文字交由人工完成。

title: 已拍角度统一展示
promptEN: Build a square three-view product board from [front photo], [rear photo] and [side photo]. Each panel must come from its corresponding photograph; never invent a rear view from one image. Give the front view a large left panel and stack the other views on the right, preserving a consistent physical scale and orientation logic. Normalize white balance and soft-light brightness over neutral pale gray with modest shadows. Clean dust and backgrounds but keep genuine screws, ports, labels and seams. Preserve the long, thin proportions of hardware such as RAM. Separate panels with whitespace and safe margins. Leave missing views blank and identify the required photograph in accompanying text. Add no captions at this stage; compare color, model and component counts across panels.

promptCN: 使用[正面照片]、[背面照片]和[侧面照片]制作1080×1080三视图展示板，每个视图必须来自对应实拍，不凭单张图片创造背面结构。正面主视图占左侧较大区域，背面与侧面上下排列在右侧，三者保持同一实物尺度与朝向逻辑。背景为中性浅灰，统一白平衡与柔光亮度，阴影保持轻微且不遮挡接口。允许清洁背景与灰尘，不允许修掉真实螺丝、插口、序列标签或结构接缝，也不改变内存条等细长产品的长宽比例。每个分区保留独立安全边距，视图之间使用留白分隔，不加装饰边框。缺少某一视图时留空并注明所需补图。此轮不生成文字标签，优先检查不同视图的颜色、型号和零件数量一致。

title: 电商六图拍摄与生成规划
promptEN: Act as an ecommerce visual planner using [product brief], [physical dimensions], [available photos] and [platform rules]. Plan six images: white-background hero, material detail, dimensions card, actual use context, package inventory and verified specifications. For each, state purpose, aspect ratio, subject size, viewpoint, lighting, copy area and required references. Use a 1080-square delivery target or 3:4 detail layout unless platform rules require otherwise. Protect thin hardware geometry and white-product edge detail; schedule another photograph for undocumented faces. Separate visible facts from specifications requiring merchant confirmation and mark gaps “to confirm.” Finish with production order and acceptance checks. Use only approved Chinese copy. Return an actionable text plan without invented claims, certifications or functions.

promptCN: 你是电商视觉策划。根据[产品说明]、[实物尺寸]、[已有照片清单]和[目标平台规范]，规划六张商品图：白底主图、材质特写、尺寸说明、真实使用场景、包装清单与已核实规格卡。逐张给出目的、画幅、主体占比、相机角度、光线、文案区和需要的参考素材；方图以1080×1080交付目标描述，详情图以3:4描述，平台另有要求则优先采用平台规范。明确细长硬件与白色产品的轮廓、比例和接口必须保留，隐藏面缺少实拍时安排补拍。将可由照片确认的事实和需商家核实的参数分开，缺失数据写“待确认”。最后给出制作顺序及逐图验收点，中文文案必须逐字来自已批准内容。仅输出可执行文字方案，不虚构商品卖点、认证、性能测试或产品不存在的功能。

title: 中文商品图文校对清单
promptEN: Review [original product photo], [generated image or description], [approved Chinese copy] and [verified specifications]. Return an actionable revision list. Check proportions, component counts, connector orientation and branding first, especially shortened or thickened RAM, invented light bars and altered contacts. Compare Chinese characters, English model names, numerals, currency marks and units exactly; distinguish illegible content from confirmed errors. Check white-product edge separation, consistent shadows and safe margins in square or 3:4 crops. Group findings as required corrections, optional improvements and missing information. Give a narrowly scoped edit instruction for each issue and identify what must remain unchanged. Mark verified items “pass” and unresolved items “to confirm.” Do not supply new prices or performance promises.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 你是商品图终审编辑。输入[原始商品照片]、[生成图描述或上传图]、[批准的中文文案]与[真实参数表]，输出可直接执行的修订清单。先检查商品长宽比例、零件数量、接口朝向和品牌标识，尤其关注内存条是否被拉短、加厚、增加灯条或改变金手指。再逐字核对中文、英文型号、数字、货币符号与单位，区分看不清和确实错误，不能猜测模糊文字。检查白色外壳在白底上是否保有边缘、阴影方向是否一致、1080方图或3:4裁切是否留足安全区。按“必须修正、建议优化、需补资料”三类列出问题，并为每个问题给一条范围明确的局部编辑指令，说明需要保留的部分。未发现问题的项写“通过”，无法核实的项写“待确认”，不要替商家补充价格与性能承诺。

title: 自然窗光职业半身像
promptEN: Use [authorized portrait] as the identity reference for a natural half-length [professional purpose] portrait. Preserve facial structure, feature spacing, skin tone, age cues and distinctive visible marks. Dress the person in [simple outfit], turn the body slightly right and maintain a calm camera-facing gaze with relaxed shoulders and hands outside the frame. A large left window supplies diffuse light with gentle ambient fill. Keep natural skin texture and tonal transitions. Use a softly blurred warm-gray office background with believable depth. Frame vertically at 3:4 with comfortable headroom, photographing at eye level to avoid wide-angle distortion. Include no new text, logos, jewelry or unrelated makeup.

promptCN: 以[本人授权肖像]为身份参考，为[职业用途]制作自然的半身人像。保持脸部骨骼、五官间距、肤色、年龄特征和可见独特标记，不做瘦脸、换脸或夸张美颜。人物穿[简洁服装]，身体略向画面右侧转动，视线温和看向镜头，双肩放松，双手位于画面外。左侧大窗提供柔和散射光，右侧少量环境补光，皮肤保留细微纹理与自然明暗过渡。背景为浅暖灰办公空间，轻度虚化而仍有真实纵深。构图采用3:4竖幅，头顶与肩部保留适当空间，镜头位于眼睛高度，避免广角导致鼻部放大。画面不添加文字、公司标识、珠宝或与参考无关的妆容，整体表达可靠、平和且接近日常本人状态的职业形象。

title: 手作匠人环境肖像
promptEN: An adult [craftsperson] beside a workbench in a [studio type], attentively arranging a finished [handmade object]. Place the person on the right third and show an orderly tool shelf, a few works in progress and tactile wood or fabric on the left. The studio looks used but cared for. High side-window light gives gentle direction and readable facial shadows. Use an eye-level medium environmental portrait that explains both person and workspace. Hands should naturally touch one clearly defined object rather than form a complicated gesture. Favor [warm brown/muted blue], realistic skin and workwear folds. Compose in 3:4 with no branding, captions, artificial smoke, awards or invented credentials; convey quiet concentration.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 一位[成年手作匠人]坐在[工作室类型]的工作台旁，正专注整理已经完成的[手工作品]，呈现有温度的环境肖像。人物位于画面右侧三分之一，左侧保留有序工具架、少量半成品与木材或布料纹理，环境真实使用过但不杂乱。光线从高处侧窗照入，形成柔和方向感，面部阴影保留细节，避免舞台追光。采用平视的中景，画面同时说明人的状态与工作空间，双手自然接触一件清楚可辨的作品，不出现复杂交叠手势。色彩以[暖棕/低饱和蓝]为主，保留皮肤纹理与工作服褶皱。构图3:4，不加品牌、字幕或夸张烟尘，不虚构奖项或职业认证。整体接近一张经过认真构图的编辑纪实照片，情绪安静而专注。

title: 深色背景柔和轮廓像
promptEN: A head-and-shoulders studio portrait of [adult subject], facing the camera with the head turned slightly left and a composed expression. Use a deep charcoal seamless backdrop. A large softbox above camera left shapes the cheeks; a faint rear-right rim separates hair and shoulder without colored patches on the face. The [dark plain top] has subtly different texture from the background. Use natural medium-telephoto portrait perspective and focus on the nearer eye, keeping both eyes and the main facial contours clear. Preserve pores, individual hairs and restrained skin sheen. Compose at 4:5 with breathing room, minimal accessories and no lettering or exaggerated halo. The mood is steady and restrained.

promptCN: 一位[成年人物描述]的肩部以上棚拍肖像，人物面向镜头，头部轻微转向左侧，神情沉静。背景为深炭灰无缝布，不出现可辨认环境。主光是镜头左侧的大型柔光箱，略高于眼睛，使面颊形成柔和明暗；右后方一条低亮度轮廓光只勾勒肩部和头发边缘，不在脸上形成彩色光斑。服装为无图案的[深色上衣]，质地与背景有细微区别。采用接近中长焦肖像的自然透视，焦点在近侧眼睛，双眼与主要面部轮廓清楚，耳朵允许轻微变柔。保留真实毛孔、发丝与适量皮肤光泽，不磨成塑料质感。画幅4:5，人物周围有呼吸空间，不加文字、额外饰物或夸张光晕，整体克制、安定而具有层次。

title: 雨日咖啡馆情绪肖像
promptEN: An adult [subject] in [everyday coat] seated at a café window on a rainy day, quietly looking outside. A plain ceramic cup and closed book are the only tabletop objects. Place the person on the left third and sparse rain droplets with soft street colors on the right. Keep reflections faint and away from the eyes, without a duplicate face. Cool diffuse window light shapes the profile; restrained warm interior light touches the clothing and table while skin remains natural. Use an eye-level medium close-up focused on the visible eye and cheek. Compose at 3:4 in muted colors with textured shadows. Hands rest simply beside the book. Convey reflective waiting without dramatic sadness, lettering, logos or extra people.

promptCN: 一位[成年人物]坐在雨天咖啡馆的窗边，穿[日常外套]，安静地望向窗外，桌面上只有一只普通陶瓷杯和一本合上的书。人物位于左侧三分之一，右侧窗面可见稀疏雨滴与柔化的街道色块，玻璃反射只轻微叠加，不覆盖眼睛或制造第二张脸。来自窗外的冷柔光照亮侧脸，室内暖光仅在衣物边缘和桌面形成适度色差，肤色仍然自然。采用平视中近景，保留少量环境，焦点落在人眼与近侧面颊，窗外细节柔化。竖幅3:4，色彩低饱和，暗部有纹理，画面体现等待与思考而非戏剧化悲伤。不加入字幕、可识别商标、额外人物或不合理水滴，双手自然放在书旁，不出现复杂动作。

title: 只替换服装的肖像编辑
promptEN: In [authorized portrait], replace only [original clothing] with [target garment] for [professional/event purpose]. Keep the face, hair, skin, expression, pose, body shape, hands and background unchanged. Fit the garment through believable seams and folds rather than altering the body. Match shoulder line, cuffs, collar, material lighting and existing occlusions, carefully integrating hair or jewelry at the neckline. Use [exact color] and [solid/provided pattern] without invented logos or accessories. Retain the original crop. Limit edits to the clothes and necessary edge shadows. Compare identity features with the original and inspect the neckline for intrusions into skin, hair or background and for remnants of the previous outfit.

promptCN: 使用[授权人物照片]，仅将人物身上的[原服装]替换为[目标服装描述]，用途为[职业/活动]形象展示。人物的脸、发型、肤色、表情、姿态、体型、手部和背景全部保持原状，不能通过修改身形来让衣服合身。新服装依照原姿势产生自然褶皱、肩线、袖口与领口，材质受光与原图一致，保留合理遮挡关系，项链或头发与衣领接触处需要仔细融合。颜色采用[准确颜色]，图案为[纯色/已提供纹样]，不生成品牌标识、口袋装饰或未指定配件。沿用原画幅和裁切，修改范围严格限制在衣物及必要的边缘阴影。输出前逐项比较人物身份特征与原图，检查衣领边缘是否侵入下巴、头发或背景，避免出现残留旧衣和不自然皮肤。

title: 两代人自然合影
promptEN: Two adult [family members] seated together on a park bench, the older person turning slightly toward the other as they share a quiet smile. Give each distinct facial structure, hair and clothing. Keep relaxed poses, shoulders naturally close and hands separately resting on their own laps. Soft trees and a distant path form a layered background without branches intersecting heads. Late-day open shade provides even light and preserves age texture rather than rejuvenating the older person. Frame horizontally at 4:3 from seated eye level, with the people prominent and some environment visible. Coordinate different outfits in [natural palette]. Aim for a carefully made, believable family photograph without lettering, exaggerated blur or extra passersby.

promptCN: 两位[成年家庭成员描述]在公园长椅上并排坐着，年长者轻轻侧向另一位，分享一个平静的微笑。人物有清楚区别的脸型、发型与衣着，不出现近似复制的面孔。两人的坐姿放松，肩部自然靠近，双手分别放在自己的腿上，避免交叉手指和复杂拥抱。背景是一片柔化的树荫与远处步道，少量叶片形成明暗层次，不在头顶生成奇怪枝条。傍晚开放阴影提供均匀柔光，皮肤保留年龄纹理，不将年长者过度年轻化。构图横幅4:3，镜头与坐姿眼睛同高，人物占画面主要区域，四周保留环境。服装采用互相协调但不同的[自然色系]，整体温暖、可信，像一张细心拍摄的家庭照片，不加文字、夸张景深或额外路人。

title: 透明玻璃器物边缘光
promptEN: A [transparent glass object] with [physical shape] on pale-gray seamless paper, unbranded and unengraved, as a material-study still life. Place the complete silhouette slightly left of center and reserve a clean right third. Narrow soft sources at both sides define the edges; very weak frontal bounce reveals thickness. Keep believable internal refraction and tonal changes instead of impossible background lines. Include a faint contact shadow, clean highlights and visible transparency rather than milky plastic. Use a slightly elevated, near-level close view at 4:5 with sufficient focus over the main outline. Show convincing thickness, clarity and shape without floating effects, smoke, extra liquid or lettering.

promptCN: 一只[透明玻璃器物]置于浅灰无缝背景上，器物结构为[真实形态描述]，没有品牌与刻字，作为材质研究静物。主体偏左居中，完整外轮廓与底部均在画面内，右侧保留三分之一干净留白。两侧使用细长柔光源勾勒玻璃边缘，前方以极弱漫反射补光显示厚度，器物内部保留合理折射与明暗变化，背景线条不穿透成不可能的结构。底部有轻微真实接触影，不添加漂浮效果、烟雾或多余液体。玻璃表面洁净但不失真实微小高光，透明部分与背景保持区别，不渲染成乳白塑料。采用平视略俯的中近景，画幅4:5，焦点覆盖主要轮廓，整体光线克制，突出薄厚、通透与形状的物理可信度，画面不出现文字。

title: 白瓷器物柔光静物
promptEN: An unbranded [white porcelain cup] and [matching saucer] on a warm pale-gray table against a slightly darker backdrop. Keep the complete cup visible, handle to the right, with believable relative dimensions and a small separating gap. Large diffuse light from upper front left and low fill on the right preserve cup-wall shading, glaze reflections and highlight detail. Photograph from a low three-quarter angle with the rim and handle in focus and the background gradually softer. Use a balanced square composition with generous whitespace. Keep a warm white ceramic finish rather than metallic silver. Include no patterns, cracks, branding, text, flowers, extra utensils or fabric; emphasize form and soft volume.

promptCN: 一组由[白瓷杯]与[白瓷碟]组成的静物，放在淡暖灰桌面，背景比瓷器略深，帮助观察白色轮廓。杯身完整可见，杯碟按照真实尺寸摆放，杯柄朝画面右侧，两者之间留出小距离，不形成误导性的融合结构。光线来自左前上方的大面积漫射光，右侧低亮度补光保留杯壁阴影与釉面细微反射，最高光保有层次。以接近桌面高度的三分之四角度拍摄，焦点同时覆盖杯口和杯柄，背景缓慢柔化。画幅1:1，构图安静，四周留出均衡空白。瓷器保持温润白色与细致釉感，不染成金属银，不生成花纹、裂纹、品牌和文字。桌面只有这一组器物，避免鲜花、餐具或布料抢夺注意力，强调形状、留白与柔和体积感。

title: 草图转可信材质概念
promptEN: Translate [product sketch] into a physically plausible material concept for design discussion. Preserve its silhouette, structural divisions, component count, proportions and perspective. Assign [shell material], [button material] and [support material]; use neutral matte finishes for unspecified regions. Add no ports, screens, screws or decorative seams. Keep the original orientation and aspect ratio with the complete object centered on pale-gray seamless paper. A large upper-left soft source and support-consistent contact shadow should reveal volume, with distinct reflection and roughness for each material. Present an appearance concept rather than a claim of a manufactured product. Include no lettering, specifications, branding or functional icons. Verify that every structural line corresponds to the sketch.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 将[产品设计草图]转换为具有可信材质与光线的概念渲染，仅用作设计讨论，严格保持原草图的轮廓、结构分区、部件数量、相互比例和视角。表面材质依次为[外壳材质]、[按键材质]与[支架材质]，未注明的区域使用中性哑光处理，不新增接口、屏幕、螺丝或装饰线。产品置于浅灰无缝背景，保持草图原有朝向，主体完整居中，留出足够边距。左上方大型柔光形成明确但柔和的体积感，底部接触阴影符合支撑结构，反射与粗糙度随材质区别。画面应像严谨的外观方案呈现，而非展示已经量产的实物。沿用输入画幅，不加文字、参数、品牌或功能图标。最后检查所有结构线是否与草图对应，尤其避免把简化草图擅自解释成新功能。

title: 织物折叠与纹理研究
promptEN: A [linen/cotton] textile in [exact color], naturally folded into three tidy layers on a neutral light table. Show genuine weave direction, hem and soft creases in the foreground while the rear becomes gently softer. Keep the main fold outlines readable. Soft left window light grazes the fibers with low reflected fill preserving shadows. Use a close viewpoint just above the table at 4:5, with fabric filling roughly two thirds and some breathing space above. Maintain realistic fiber scale and weight-driven drape, avoiding rope-like texture, plastic shine, metallic reflections, floating folds or sharp impossible creases. Include no extra objects, lettering, tags or complex patterns. Convey tactile, restrained material detail.

promptCN: 一块[亚麻/棉质]织物以三层整齐而自然的折叠方式放在中性浅色台面上，颜色为[准确色名]，作为产品材质研究图。前景展示清楚的织线方向、缝边与柔软折痕，后部逐渐柔化，但主要折叠轮廓都可辨认。柔和侧窗光从左侧掠过表面，表现纤维之间的细微起伏，右侧以低强度反射补光保留暗部。使用略高于桌面的近景视角，构图4:5，织物占画面约三分之二，顶部留有少量呼吸空间。材质保持真实的纤维尺度，不生成粗到像绳索的纹理，也不呈现塑料或金属反光。桌面不出现其他物品，布上没有文字、标签或复杂图案。整体低饱和、自然、细致，强调手感与重量形成的垂坠感，不增加不合理悬浮或尖锐折角。

title: 仅替换外壳颜色
promptEN: Edit only [specified shell region] in [product reference], changing [original color] to [target color/reference] for a colorway comparison. Keep proportions, controls, ports, holes, screws, branding, background, camera and crop unchanged. Exclude mirrors, transparent parts, gold contacts and labels from recoloring. Apply the new hue through the original lighting, highlights, shadows and environmental reflections while retaining [sandblasted/matte/brushed] roughness. Do not transform the material into plastic or chrome. Treat the displayed hue as a visual approximation rather than a physical color guarantee. Add no lettering, accessories or features. Inspect for edge spill, altered labels and deformation, especially on long thin hardware.

title: 分解结构图依据规划
promptEN: An uncluttered exploded structure concept of [product], using only [verified component list and teardown references]. Separate shell, fasteners and internal assemblies modestly along the assembly axis, preserving actual relative sizes, order and alignment. Add no invented circuits, screws or sensors. Use pale gray and neutral soft light, with complete, clear-edged parts and readable but restrained separation. Frame at 3:4, reserving the right side for later explanatory copy without generating labels. Match documented materials and circuit-board colors; keep white plastic dimensional and metal reflections controlled. If internal evidence is insufficient, show only documented external assemblies and leave unknown regions unresolved. Communicate component relationships without implying repair instructions or performance claims.

title: 城市周末工作坊海报

An overhead pale worktable holds three unbranded [materials] and one completed object in a loose arc directing the eye upward. Use [main color] and cream with tactile paper and soft side-lit shadows. Render only “[event title]” at the top, “[date]” and “[venue]” beneath, and “[registration instruction]” at the bottom, with readable Chinese type, clear hierarchy and safe margins. Omit missing information. Add no QR code, phone number, partner logo or price. Keep the design welcoming and spacious without busy stickers or dramatic effects. Reserve blank text areas if exact lettering cannot be reproduced. Imply only the supplied workshop activities.

title: 新品发布横幅留白

Leave roughly 45 percent flat space on the left for later headline and button placement. Build a low-contrast [brand color] and neutral-gray environment with one simple supporting plinth that neither blocks ports nor distorts scale. Soft front-side lighting and a restrained rim separate white surfaces from the background. Match shadows, reflections and perspective. Limit decoration to one faint geometric form. Include no copy, prices, release dates, promotional terms, bursts, particles or unrelated functional icons. Express [brand character] and verify labels and thin structures after compositing.

promptCN: 将[新品实拍]转换成16:9横幅，服务于[发布渠道]的新品介绍。完整商品放在画面右侧，保持真实形状、比例、材质、标志与可见部件，左侧约百分之四十五保持平整留白，供后期放置标题与按钮。背景以[品牌主色]和中性灰形成低对比空间，加入一块简洁几何台面承托商品，台面不能挡住重要接口或改变实物尺度。柔和侧前光突出轮廓，背后轻微边缘光帮助白色产品与背景分离，阴影、反射和透视一致。装饰限于一处低对比几何形状，不添加爆炸光、粒子或与功能无关的图标。此轮不生成文案、价格、发布日期和促销条款。画面表达[品牌气质]，将注意力集中在商品本身，最后核对产品标签与细长结构未因合成而变形。

title: 通讯封面抽象知识视觉
promptEN: A 16:9 editorial newsletter cover for [issue topic], using [central metaphor] instead of a pile of industry icons. Show at most five [specific geometric or paper objects] arranged through [connection/unfolding/order] to suggest information becoming organized. Use matte paper forms, subtle dimensional shadows and [brand color], pale gray and one warm accent. Light from upper left without elaborate gradients or glare. Place the visual in the right two thirds and reserve clean title space on the left. Include restrained paper texture without a vintage treatment. Generate no lettering, charts, code, trademarks or unverified technical structures. Keep the metaphor readable at thumbnail size and avoid implying actual measurements or experimental results.
