promptCN: 为主题为[本期主题]的专业通讯设计16:9封面插画，用[核心比喻]表达主题，而不是直接堆砌行业图标。画面主体是一组[具体几何物/纸张构件]，通过[连接、展开或排序关系]体现信息被整理的过程，所有关系清楚可读，物体数量控制在五个以内。采用哑光纸艺与轻微立体投影，配色为[品牌色]、浅灰和一点暖色强调，光源来自左上方，避免复杂渐变与炫光。主体放在右侧三分之二，左侧保留干净的标题空间，背景有少量自然纸纹但不过分复古。此轮不生成文字、数据图表、代码、商标或未经核实的技术结构。构图应在缩略图中仍能辨识，体现清楚、可信和有思考的编辑气质，不让抽象图形暗示具体数据或实验结果。

title: 季节礼赠品牌情绪图
promptEN: Create a 3:4 gifting visual for [holiday/season] using [product photograph]. Keep the complete item at lower center with its actual proportions, marks, materials and color. Add only a [brand color] ribbon and blank card; include a gift box only if that packaging is actually supplied. Use a warm neutral background with minimal [seasonal plant/texture] at the edges, avoiding obstruction or misleading implied gifts. Broad upper-left light should preserve white-product edge tones and consistent ribbon shadows. Leave the upper region open for copy. Convey thoughtfulness and everyday quality without invented discounts, environmental certifications or gift promises. Generate no headline, price or card lettering. Check decorative scale and contact shadows while retaining the product as the focus.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 以[产品照片]为主体，设计用于[节日/季节]礼赠活动的3:4品牌氛围图。商品完整置于画面下方中央，保留真实尺寸关系、标识、材质和颜色，旁边只出现一条[品牌色]丝带与一张空白卡片，礼盒仅在商家确实提供该包装时使用。背景为浅暖中性色，加入极少量[当季植物或纹理]作为边缘点缀，避免遮挡产品与制造误导性赠品。宽大柔光从左上方照入，白色产品边缘有柔和灰阶，丝带与商品阴影方向一致，上方留出完整文案区域。氛围表达体贴、轻盈与日常品质，不增加虚构优惠、环保认证或礼品承诺。此阶段不生成中文标题、价格或卡片文字，也不改变商品包装内容。检查装饰比例与接触阴影，确保主商品始终是画面焦点。

title: 三张社交内容视觉系列
promptEN: Design three separate square social visuals for [brand] and [content theme], not a collage. Keep [main and accent colors], matte materials, upper-left soft light and identical safe margins. Card one uses [single object] to represent the problem, card two uses [a clear relation between two objects] for the method, and card three uses [an ordered scene] for the outcome. Limit each to four objects and maintain thumbnail clarity. Treat arrangements as metaphors, not unverified data, percentages or product features. Place subjects in the lower two thirds and reserve the top for approved copy. Generate no lettering, brand icons, buttons or interface screenshots. Match color temperature, shadow softness and object scale while making each arrangement distinct.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 为[品牌]的[内容主题]设计一套三张方形社交配图，先分别输出三个独立画面，而非将三张拼成一张。统一使用[主色与辅助色]、哑光材质、左上方柔光和相同的边缘留白。第一张用[单一物体]表现问题，第二张用[两个物体的明确关系]表现方法，第三张用[整理完成的场景]表现结果；每张物体不超过四个，构图要在手机缩略图中仍清晰。图形关系只作为概念比喻，不把它们画成未经证实的数据、百分比或产品功能。主体位于下方约三分之二，上方留给后期标题，画面不直接生成文字、图标品牌、按钮或界面截图。三张之间保持色温、阴影软硬和物体尺度一致，同时让物体安排有清楚区别。整体简洁、有节奏，方便之后加入经过审核的中文文案。

title: 服务流程隐喻视觉
promptEN: A 16:9 website visual explaining [customer value] for [service]. Three simple [material] platforms are linked by one gently continuous ribbon, each holding one [stage-related tangible object], suggesting movement from [starting point] to [outcome]. Keep platform perspective and heights coherent and give the ribbon believable support and contact without intersections. Use a pale neutral environment, restrained [brand color] accents, broad soft light and low-reflection matte surfaces. Concentrate the scene on the right and reserve about 40 percent on the left for a headline. This is a metaphor, not evidence: include no numbers, success rates, review stars, certifications or real interface elements. Maintain limited objects, readable silhouettes and a clear sequence at thumbnail size.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 为[服务名称]设计一张解释[客户价值]的官网视觉，用真实可辨的物体关系作比喻。画面由三座简洁的[材质]平台组成，一条柔和连续的带状物依次连接它们，每个平台上仅放一件[与阶段对应的具体物体]，表达从[起点]到[结果]的有序过程。平台高度与透视一致，连接带有合理接触和支撑，不穿透物体。使用浅中性色背景、[品牌色]局部强调和宽大柔光，阴影轻微，表面为低反射哑光。画幅16:9，主体集中右侧，左侧留出约四成空间供标题。视觉仅表达概念，不画数字、成功率、评价星级、认证或真实产品界面，不暗示未经核实的服务结果。保持物体数量有限、轮廓清楚、阅读顺序明确，整体平和、可靠，在缩略图下也易于理解。

title: 清晨街道层次摄影
promptEN: A quiet street in [city type] just reached by morning sunlight. Slightly damp stone paving forms the foreground, an ordinary parked bicycle and half-open shop door the middle ground, and faint haze narrows the distance. Avoid famous landmarks, legible signs and brands. Use eye-level street perspective with curb and building lines guiding depth, reasonable verticals and no extreme wide-angle stretch. Low sunlight from the right makes long soft shadows with retained texture. Favor warm gray, pale blue and small brick-red accents without a heavy filter. Compose horizontally at 3:2, focusing near the bicycle and softening distance naturally. Keep everyday wear without crowds, artificial smoke or dramatic light shafts.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 一条位于[城市类型]的安静街道在清晨刚被阳光照亮，前景是一小片带细微水迹的石质路面，中景有一辆停靠的普通自行车和半开的店门，远处街道在轻微薄雾中收束。画面不依赖知名地标，不生成可读招牌与品牌。采用人眼高度的自然街头视角，用路沿和建筑线条引导纵深，保持垂直线合理，不出现极端广角拉伸。阳光从右侧低角度照入，形成长而柔和的阴影，阴影区域仍有材质细节；色彩以暖灰、淡蓝和少量砖红为主，避免浓重滤镜。横幅3:2，前、中、远景都清楚分层，焦点在中景自行车附近，远处自然柔化。街道干净但有日常磨损痕迹，不加入额外人群、戏剧烟雾或夸张光柱，呈现真实而平静的城市早晨。

title: 雨后森林小径摄影
promptEN: A narrow soil path in [temperate forest type] after rain, curving from lower left into the distance. Wet leaves, modest moss and small stones fill the foreground; irregularly spaced trunks layer the middle ground. Overcast skylight gives soft illumination and scattered tiny leaf reflections, with damp air but no dense fog. Use walking eye level and a 3:2 frame, believable path width and tree scale, natural verticals and non-repeating bark. Work in varied greens, earth brown and muted gray, preserving leaf detail in shadows and restrained highlights. Focus near the path bend and soften distance gradually rather than using miniature-like blur. Include no people, animals, text or artificial beams; emphasize wet texture and quiet depth.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 雨后[温带森林类型]中的一条狭窄泥土小径，从画面左下方轻轻转向远处，前景可见湿润落叶、少量苔藓和自然碎石，中景树干形成疏密有序的层次。光线为云层遮蔽下的柔和天光，叶面只有零星细小反光，空气稍有湿润感但不充满浓雾。采用接近步行时眼睛高度的视角，画幅3:2，小径宽度与树木尺度合理，树干垂直方向自然，没有奇怪分叉或重复纹理。色彩以深浅绿色、土褐和低饱和灰为主，暗部保留叶片细节，亮部不过曝。焦点落在中近景的小径弯处，远处平缓柔化，不制造极端微缩景深。画面没有人物、动物、文字与不合理光束，重点呈现湿润材质、空间纵深和安静步行的真实感，而不是幻想森林。

title: 自然窗光早餐静物
promptEN: A single serving of [breakfast food] on an ordinary ceramic plate with [drink] and a simple fork on a lightly textured wood table. Keep portions, temperature cues and food surfaces believable, without plastic-looking sauces. Cups and utensils have complete coherent shapes. Diffuse left window light and slight reflected fill give gentle volume with retained white-plate detail. Photograph from roughly 45 degrees at 4:5, placing the plate slightly low and leaving some table above. Let utensils guide the eye without crossing the food. Focus across the main food and near plate edge, with the drink a little softer. Include only one linen napkin as an additional prop. Avoid lettering, brands, scattered ingredients, exaggerated steam and floating food.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 一份[早餐食物]摆在普通陶瓷盘中，旁边是一杯[饮品]与一把简单餐叉，放在带少量自然纹理的木桌上。食物分量符合一人早餐，表面质感与温度可信，酱料不形成塑料光泽，杯口和餐具保持完整正确的形状。使用左侧窗户散射光，右侧轻微反射补光，食物有柔和体积与细节，背景不过曝。视角为桌面上方约四十五度，画幅4:5，盘子偏下居中，上方保留少量桌面，餐具形成自然引导线但不穿过食物。配色温暖克制，白色餐盘仍有层次，焦点覆盖主食与盘前缘，后方饮品稍柔。环境只保留一块亚麻餐巾，不添加花瓶、文字、品牌或过量散落食材。整体像真实清晨的细致美食摄影，不使用夸张蒸汽、悬浮食物或不可能的切面。

title: 现代建筑垂直线摄影
promptEN: The façade of a [modern public building] in pale stone, clear glass and thin metal frames, with plausible masses and human-scale doors and windows. Keep the principal elevation complete, with a clean path and limited low planting in front. Avoid recognizable landmark signatures. Use a near-level architectural viewpoint with naturally corrected verticals and stable horizontals, without fisheye distortion or a leaning building. Soft morning side light reveals stone texture and glass reflections consistent with the setting. A pale-blue sky with thin clouds occupies only a modest upper band. Compose at 3:2 and retain entrance detail in shadows. Include no readable building names, logos, construction banners, invented extra floors or impossible cantilevers; emphasize material, proportion and rhythm.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 一座[现代公共建筑类型]的外立面，材质为浅色石材、透明玻璃与细金属框架，建筑体量和门窗比例符合日常使用尺度。构图中完整保留主要立面，前景有一条干净步道与少量低矮绿植，不用知名建筑标志作为主体。采用平视略抬高的建筑摄影视角，垂直线校正自然，水平线稳定，不出现倾倒楼体和夸张鱼眼透视。清晨柔和侧光表现石材纹理与玻璃反射，反射内容与环境一致，天空为淡蓝与轻薄云层。横幅3:2，立面占主要空间，上方留少量天空，暗部可辨识入口细节。不要生成可读楼名、品牌、施工标语、额外楼层或不可能的悬挑结构。画面整洁而非完全无生活痕迹，重点体现材料、比例、节奏和真实建筑空间。

title: 骑行者运动跟拍
promptEN: An adult [commuter cyclist] moving left to right on a level urban cycle lane, wearing an unbranded jacket and properly fitted helmet, hands naturally gripping the bar. Use a side-on panning view: head, torso and principal frame structure stay relatively clear while the background has moderate horizontal motion blur and spokes show plausible rotation. Keep equal wheel sizes, coherent frame geometry, pedals, limbs and road contact. Soft overcast light preserves facial and clothing detail. Use urban neutrals with [clothing accent color]. Frame horizontally at 3:2 with the rider left of center and more space ahead. Keep the horizon stable and exclude readable plates, logos, lettering, hazardous congestion, artificial speed lines and particles. Convey brisk everyday travel.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 一位[成年通勤骑行者]沿平坦城市自行车道从左向右骑行，穿普通无品牌运动外套并佩戴合适头盔，双手自然握住车把。画面采用侧面跟拍视角，人物头部、上身和车架主要结构相对清楚，背景沿水平方向形成适度运动模糊，车轮辐条有合理旋转痕迹，不能将整辆车糊成无法辨认的形状。自行车两轮尺寸相同，车架、脚踏与手脚关系正确，路面接触可信。使用阴天柔光，保持面部和衣服细节，配色以城市中性色与一处[衣物强调色]为主。横幅3:2，骑行者偏左，前进方向留出更多空间，地平线稳定。背景不出现可识别车牌、商标、文字或危险拥堵交通，整体表达轻快的日常通勤节奏，不用夸张速度线与粒子特效。

title: 移除杂物保持摄影现场
promptEN: Edit [original photograph] by removing only [specified distraction] at [precise location]. Fill its area with the surrounding documented [background material]. Preserve subjects, architecture, horizon, vegetation, light direction, color temperature, depth of field, grain and crop. Remove the object's own shadow if present while retaining other shadows and occlusions. Extend nearby perspective and texture scale without repeating patterns, smears or extra edges. Do not invent objects. For hidden details that cannot be established, use a simple locally consistent background rather than reconstructing readable lettering or faces. Compare original and edited versions to ensure changes are restricted to the target and necessary seams. Keep the same photographic character without additional retouching, grading or recomposition.
adaptationNote: 原创场景与双语模板；依据官方提示结构原则改编，未转载官方示例。输出尺寸需在所选工具中另行设置，成图文字与实物一致性需核对。
promptCN: 编辑[原始摄影照片]，仅移除画面[准确位置]的[指定杂物]，用周围真实存在的[背景材质]自然补足该区域。其余所有元素，包括主体人物或产品、建筑线条、地平线、植被、光线方向、色温、景深、颗粒和原裁切都保持不变。若杂物投下独立阴影，连同属于它的阴影一并处理，但保留其他物体的阴影与遮挡关系。补全纹理应延续附近的透视与纹理尺度，不产生重复图案、涂抹块或多余边缘，不凭空增加新物品。对于被遮住而无法确认的细节，使用与附近环境一致的简洁背景，不重建可读文字或人物五官。完成后在原图与修改图之间逐项比较，确保变化范围仅覆盖目标及必要接缝，整体仍像同一次拍摄，不进行额外美颜、调色或构图调整。

title: 城市降温社论插画
promptCN: 为一篇关于城市降温的文章绘制社论插画：一位园丁把树荫像布料一样铺在广场上。俯视构图，人物位于右下，左上保留约三分之一安静留白用于后期标题。砖红、鼠尾草绿与奶油白三色，剪纸形状叠加细纸纹，概念清晰、轮廓简洁。
promptEN: Create an editorial illustration for an article about cooling cities: a gardener spreads tree shade across a plaza as if unrolling fabric. Use an overhead composition, with the figure at lower right and a quiet upper-left third reserved for a headline added later. Limit the palette to brick red, sage green and cream; combine cut-paper shapes with subtle paper grain and clear silhouettes.

title: 雨后花市水彩
promptCN: 绘制雨后清晨的街角花市水彩插画。前景是带水珠的白色花束，中景是撑开帆布棚的摊主，远景建筑以湿画法淡化。平视中景，柔和阴天光，群青与赭石为主，保留纸白高光和自然水渍边缘，让花朵成为唯一细节密集区。
promptEN: Paint a watercolor illustration of a corner flower market on a morning after rain. Place dewy white bouquets in the foreground, a vendor opening a canvas awning in the middle ground, and softly washed buildings behind. Use an eye-level medium view, diffuse overcast light, ultramarine and ochre, reserved paper-white highlights and natural pigment blooms. Concentrate fine detail around the flowers.

title: 草图变绘本跨页
promptCN: 以所上传草图为构图参考，将它完成为温暖的儿童绘本跨页：小獾在厨房修补一只蓝色茶杯。保留草图中门窗、桌子与主角的位置关系和朝向，用彩铅叠加薄水粉完成木头、布料与陶瓷质感。暖灯照亮桌面，窗外是蓝色暮光；将中缝附近处理为低细节区域。
promptEN: Use the uploaded sketch as the composition reference and finish it as a warm children’s storybook spread: a young badger repairs a blue teacup in a kitchen. Preserve the relative positions and orientations of the windows, door, table and character. Render wood, fabric and ceramics with colored pencil over thin gouache. Warm lamplight lights the table against blue dusk outside; keep the gutter area low in detail.

title: 建筑照片线描化
promptCN: 将所上传街角照片转为精细钢笔线描。保留建筑体块、透视、门窗数量及街道边界，用有节奏的线粗变化区分前后层次，用疏密排线表达阴影，纸面保持温暖象牙色。把树叶简化为几组有方向的线簇，保留入口作为视觉焦点，整体适合旅行手账配图。
promptEN: Convert the uploaded street-corner photo into a detailed pen drawing. Preserve building masses, perspective, window and door counts, and street boundaries. Use rhythmic line-weight changes for depth and sparse-to-dense hatching for shadows on warm ivory paper. Simplify foliage into directional clusters of strokes and retain the entrance as the focal point, suitable for a travel journal.

title: 漫画式雨伞接力
promptCN: 生成一段单镜头漫画动画：雨天公交站，一位穿橙色雨衣的骑手把折叠伞递给穿蓝外套的老人。平视中景，摄影机缓慢向右横移；开始骑手举起伞，中段老人接稳，最后两人微笑，雨滴持续斜落。使用清晰墨线、平涂色块和少量半色调，人物比例与服装在整段保持一致。
promptEN: Create a continuous comic-style animated shot at a rainy bus stop. A courier in an orange raincoat offers a folded umbrella to an older person in a blue coat. In an eye-level medium shot, the camera slowly tracks right. First the courier lifts the umbrella, then the recipient takes it securely, and finally both smile as diagonal rain continues. Use crisp ink outlines, flat color and restrained halftones, with consistent proportions and clothing throughout.

title: 概念画中的浮岛苏醒
promptCN: 使用上传的浮岛概念画作为起始帧，延续原有岛体轮廓、建筑位置、绘画笔触和晨光方向。摄影机缓慢推近，前景云雾向左飘，中段岛边的小风车逐渐转动，最后瀑布水雾被阳光照亮。保持岛体与建筑结构稳定，以轻微环境运动呈现苏醒感，连续单镜头。
promptEN: Use the uploaded floating-island concept painting as the starting frame, retaining the island silhouette, building placement, brushwork and direction of morning light. Slowly push the camera forward as foreground clouds drift left. The small windmill near the island edge gradually begins turning, and finally sunlight catches the waterfall spray. Keep the island and architecture structurally stable, using gentle environmental motion to suggest awakening in one continuous shot.

title: 旅行修理师角色设定
promptCN: 绘制原创动画角色设定：一名成年旅行修理师，短卷发、橄榄色工装、橙色工具包和圆形护目镜。画面左侧放全身正面站姿，右侧放两个面部表情小图，统一身体比例、服饰细节和线条粗细。浅灰背景，清晰赛璐璐阴影，突出友善而专注的性格。
promptEN: Design an original adult anime traveling mechanic with short curly hair, olive workwear, an orange tool bag and round goggles. Place a full-body front-facing standing pose on the left and two small facial-expression studies on the right. Keep body proportions, clothing details and line weight consistent. Use a pale gray background and clear cel shading to convey a friendly, focused personality.

title: 屋顶温室夜景
promptCN: 绘制动画电影感的屋顶温室夜景：成年植物研究员坐在玻璃门口记录开花时间，城市灯光在远处闪烁。广角全景，温室位于右侧，左侧天空留出呼吸空间。室内琥珀暖光与室外青蓝月光形成对照，玻璃反射有层次，叶片形状清晰，细腻手绘背景配简洁人物。
promptEN: Illustrate an anime cinematic rooftop greenhouse at night. An adult botanist sits by its glass doorway recording a flower’s blooming time, with city lights in the distance. Use a wide establishing view, placing the greenhouse on the right and open sky on the left. Contrast amber interior light with cyan moonlight, layered glass reflections and distinct leaf shapes; pair a detailed painted background with a simply rendered character.

title: 同一角色的冬装变体
promptCN: 以上传的角色设定图作为身份参考，为同一成年角色绘制冬季旅行服装。保留脸型、眼睛形状、发型轮廓、发色、身高比例及标志性圆形耳饰；将衣服改为深蓝短棉服、米色围巾和棕色靴子。保持参考图的线条和上色方式，输出同角度全身站姿，便于并排比对。
promptEN: Use the uploaded character sheet as the identity reference and dress the same adult character for winter travel. Preserve face shape, eye shape, hair silhouette and color, height proportions and signature round earrings. Change the outfit to a short navy padded jacket, cream scarf and brown boots. Match the reference linework and coloring and show a full-body standing pose at the same angle for comparison.

title: 分镜草图清稿
promptCN: 将上传的四格分镜草图清理为统一的黑白动画分镜页。保留四格顺序、每格镜头角度、角色站位、视线方向与动作节拍，仅细化轮廓、空间透视和主要道具。用三档灰阶区分前中后景，格间留白一致，维持原有镜头连续性，使每格动作在缩略图尺度也可读。
promptEN: Clean up the uploaded four-panel storyboard into a coherent monochrome anime storyboard page. Preserve panel order, camera angle, character placement, eyelines and action beat in each panel. Refine contours, perspective and essential props only. Separate foreground, middle ground and background with three gray values, use even gutters, and maintain shot continuity so that each action reads at thumbnail size.

title: 机甲工坊启动镜头
promptCN: 生成原创动画机甲工坊的连续单镜头：一台白灰色救援机甲站在检修架上，胸前有橙色救援标识。低机位中远景，摄影机缓慢向上抬升；开始胸部指示灯依次亮起，中段手指轻轻握合，最后头部转向工坊敞开的门。冷色顶灯配暖色门光，赛璐璐机械绘制，动作沉稳、关节结构连贯。
promptEN: Create one continuous anime shot inside a workshop. A white-and-gray rescue mecha stands on a service platform, marked with an orange rescue emblem. Begin with a low-angle medium-wide view and slowly crane upward. First its chest indicators illuminate in sequence, then its fingers gently close, and finally its head turns toward the open workshop door. Combine cool overhead lights with warm doorway light, cel-shaded machinery and deliberate, mechanically coherent joint motion.

title: Q版角色挥手问候
promptCN: 以上传Q版角色图作为起始帧，保留角色的头身比、面部特征、服装颜色和背景布局。固定平视中景，角色先眨一次眼，再抬起右手缓慢挥动两次，最后回到轻松站姿；头发尖和衣摆随动作轻轻摆动。动作幅度小而清楚，维持原图线条、平涂色块和身体结构，连续单镜头。
promptEN: Use the uploaded chibi character image as the starting frame, retaining its head-to-body ratio, facial features, clothing colors and background layout. In a locked eye-level medium shot, the character blinks once, raises the right hand for two slow waves, and returns to a relaxed stance. Hair tips and the hem move gently with the gesture. Keep movements small and readable, preserving the original linework, flat colors and body structure in one continuous shot.

title: 小户型阅读角
promptCN: 为一间小户型公寓生成写实阅读角设计图：窗边一张胡桃木长凳，下方收纳书籍，旁边一盏纸质落地灯。平视两点透视，入口方向拍摄，保留可通行的地面空间。奶油色墙面、浅灰织物与温润木材，上午侧光展现真实尺度、接缝与柔和阴影，适合室内方案汇报。
promptEN: Create a photorealistic reading-corner concept for a compact apartment: a walnut bench under a window, books stored beneath, and a paper floor lamp beside it. View from the entry at eye level with two-point perspective and a clearly usable floor passage. Combine cream walls, pale gray textiles and warm wood; morning side light should reveal credible scale, joints and soft shadows for an interior-design presentation.

title: 循环材料零售空间
promptCN: 生成一间小型生活用品零售店的室内设计效果图。中央是低矮的再生木展示台，两侧是可拆卸金属货架，后墙有整齐的补充装容器。入口平视广角，主通道清晰，商品数量适中；用雾绿、米白与深灰建立分区，漫射顶光和局部货架灯强调材料真实纹理。
promptEN: Visualize a small home-goods retail interior. Place a low reclaimed-wood display table centrally, demountable metal shelves along the sides and neatly arranged refill containers on the rear wall. Use an eye-level wide view from the entrance, a clear main aisle and a moderate product density. Zone the space with muted green, off-white and charcoal; diffuse overhead light and local shelf lighting reveal authentic material textures.

title: 咖啡馆软装更新
promptCN: 以上传咖啡馆照片为基础更新软装。保留墙体、门窗、吧台、天花高度与原始拍摄视角；将桌椅改为浅橡木与墨绿织物，靠窗增加两盆小型植物，灯罩统一为乳白玻璃。延续原图光照方向和空间尺度，使用真实可落地的家具比例，呈现温暖、安静的日常咖啡馆。
promptEN: Refresh the furnishings in the uploaded cafe photo. Preserve the walls, doors, windows, counter, ceiling height and original viewpoint. Replace the seating with light oak and forest-green upholstery, add two small plants by the window, and use matching opal-glass lampshades. Retain the original light direction and spatial scale, with practical furniture proportions for a warm, quiet everyday cafe.

title: 外立面材料替换
promptCN: 将上传建筑效果图的外立面改为暖灰石灰石与深色金属窗框的材料方案。保留建筑体量、楼层数量、所有开窗位置、景观布置、镜头角度和天气；仅调整对应表面的材质、接缝与反射。用细腻哑光石材、合理板块尺寸和轻微色差呈现可施工质感，保持入口辨识度。
promptEN: Change the facade materials in the uploaded architectural rendering to warm-gray limestone and dark metal window frames. Preserve building massing, floor count, every window location, landscape layout, camera angle and weather. Adjust only the relevant surface materials, joints and reflections. Use finely textured matte stone, plausible panel dimensions and subtle color variation, keeping the entrance clearly identifiable.

title: 天窗光斑的室内短片
promptCN: 生成一段建筑氛围短片：安静的双层高美术馆大厅，浅色石地面、木质长凳和格栅天窗。固定广角镜头，开始柔光铺满大厅，中段云层移开，清晰的格栅光斑缓慢移过地面，最后停在长凳前缘。呈现压缩时间的日照变化，建筑边线与家具位置稳定，写实柔和材质。
promptEN: Create an architectural atmosphere film of a quiet double-height gallery with pale stone flooring, a wooden bench and a gridded skylight. Use a locked wide shot. Begin with diffuse light across the hall; as clouds clear, distinct grid-shaped sunlight patches slowly cross the floor and finish at the bench’s front edge. Show this as compressed-time daylight change, with stable architectural lines, fixed furnishings and realistic soft materials.

title: 建筑入口缓慢推进
promptCN: 以上传建筑入口效果图作为起始帧，延续墙体比例、门窗位置、材料和晴天光照。摄影机沿现有步道缓慢前进，从中远景接近入口，结尾停在门廊外；近处植物形成轻微视差，叶片随微风摆动。保持垂直线稳定与建筑几何连贯，以自然步行速度完成连续单镜头。
promptEN: Use the uploaded entrance rendering as the starting frame, retaining wall proportions, door and window positions, materials and sunny lighting. Move the camera slowly forward along the existing path, approaching from a medium-wide view and stopping outside the porch. Nearby plants create mild parallax as leaves stir in a light breeze. Keep verticals stable and architectural geometry coherent in a continuous shot at a natural walking pace.

title: 山谷晨雾层次
promptCN: 生成写实山谷景观：近景湿润岩石和矮草，中景一条蜿蜒河流，远景层叠山峰隐入晨雾。低机位广角，河流引导视线至画面右上方；清晨逆光勾亮薄雾，冷蓝山体与少量金色草尖形成对照，空气透视清楚，保留真实地形尺度。
promptEN: Create a realistic mountain-valley landscape with wet rocks and low grass in the foreground, a winding river in the middle ground and layered peaks fading into morning mist. Use a low wide-angle view, letting the river lead toward the upper right. Backlight the mist at dawn, contrasting cool blue mountains with a few golden grass tips. Maintain clear atmospheric perspective and credible terrain scale.

title: 森林溪流生态画面
promptCN: 绘制细腻写实的温带森林溪流环境图。苔藓覆盖倒木，清水绕过浅色石头，蕨类沿岸生长，树冠间透下斑驳光点。平视中远景，以倒木作前景框架，溪流作为中轴但略偏左。绿色层次丰富，湿润表面反光柔和，让细节由近到远逐渐减少。
promptEN: Create a detailed realistic temperate-forest stream environment. Moss covers a fallen log, clear water bends around pale stones and ferns line the bank beneath dappled canopy light. Use an eye-level medium-wide view with the log framing the foreground and the stream slightly left of center. Build varied greens, gentle reflections on damp surfaces and progressively less detail toward the distance.

title: 海岸照片转环境概念画
promptCN: 以上传海岸照片为地形参考，将其转为清晰的游戏环境概念画。保留海湾轮廓、礁石位置、水平线与观察角度；将天空调整为雨后通透的蓝灰色，海水呈青绿色，近岸石缝增加少量盐生植物。使用大色块组织明暗，局部笔触细化焦点礁石，保持海岸尺度可信。
promptEN: Use the uploaded coastal photo as the terrain reference and turn it into a clear game-environment concept painting. Preserve the bay outline, rock positions, horizon and viewing angle. Shift the sky to clear blue-gray after rain, the water to turquoise, and add a few salt-tolerant plants in coastal rock cracks. Organize values with broad color masses and refine the focal rocks with selective brushwork, keeping the shoreline scale credible.

title: 沙漠白昼转蓝调时刻
promptCN: 将上传的沙漠景观照片改为日落后的蓝调时刻。保留沙丘轮廓、地平线、岩石分布和取景构图；把天空转为由淡紫过渡到深蓝的渐层，沙面阴影柔和加深，地平线保留细窄的暖橙余晖。使色温和反射光协调，沙纹细节保持清晰，呈现宁静而真实的环境。
promptEN: Transform the uploaded desert landscape photo into blue hour after sunset. Preserve dune silhouettes, horizon, rock distribution and framing. Shift the sky from pale violet into deep blue, softly deepen the dune shadows and retain a narrow warm-orange afterglow along the horizon. Coordinate color temperature and reflected light while retaining crisp sand ripples for a quiet, realistic environment.

title: 雪林风起的静谧镜头
titleEN: A Breeze Through a Snowy Forest
promptCN: 生成写实雪林短片：一条窄步道穿过积雪松树，清晨淡粉天空映在远处。固定广角镜头，开始细雪缓慢飘落，中段一阵轻风让右侧松枝轻晃并落下一小簇积雪，最后树枝恢复平静。细雪持续、运动轻柔，低对比冷色调，雪面保留细微纹理，连续单镜头。
promptEN: Create a realistic snowy-forest film with a narrow path between snow-laden pines and a pale pink dawn sky in the distance. Use a locked wide shot. Fine snow falls slowly at first; a light breeze then moves the branches on the right and releases a small clump of snow; finally the branches settle. Keep the snowfall continuous and motion gentle, with cool low-contrast colors and delicate snow textures in one uninterrupted shot.

title: 未来湿地城市苏醒
promptCN: 使用上传的未来湿地城市概念图作为起始帧，保留塔楼轮廓、桥梁位置、植被分区及原有色彩。摄影机缓慢向左横移，近景芦苇轻摆，水面细小涟漪逐渐扩散；随后一艘已有的小型渡船沿原河道向远方移动。维持建筑稳定和自然视差，以清晨宁静节奏完成连续单镜头。
promptEN: Use the uploaded future wetland-city concept image as the starting frame, retaining tower silhouettes, bridge positions, planting zones and palette. Slowly track the camera left as foreground reeds sway and small water ripples spread. Then the existing small ferry moves away along the original channel. Keep buildings stable and parallax natural, maintaining a quiet dawn rhythm in one continuous shot.

title: 茶品牌视觉方向板
promptCN: 为虚构茶品牌“山间 / SHANJIAN”生成一张品牌视觉方向板。包括一个简洁山线符号、清晰品牌字样、松绿与米白主色块、纸质吊牌及茶罐正面样机，使用规整网格和宽松留白。风格朴素现代，纸张纹理细腻，图形语言一致，文字内容仅使用给定品牌名。
promptEN: Create a brand visual direction board for a fictional tea brand named “山间 / SHANJIAN”. Include a simple mountain-line symbol, a clearly rendered brand wordmark, pine-green and cream color swatches, a paper tag and a front-view tea-tin mockup. Use an orderly grid, generous whitespace, restrained contemporary styling and subtle paper textures. Keep the graphic language consistent and limit wording to the supplied brand name.

title: 柑橘汽水包装概念
promptCN: 为虚构柑橘汽水“POME”绘制包装设计展示：一个直立铝罐，罐身为奶白底、橘红几何果片图形和清晰的大写“POME”，小字仅写“CITRUS”。浅灰棚拍背景，正面略带侧角，柔光表现铝罐弧度与印刷哑光质感。图形层级简洁，适合作为包装方向提案。
promptEN: Create a packaging concept presentation for fictional citrus soda “POME”: one upright aluminum can with an off-white base, orange-red geometric fruit slices and a clear uppercase “POME” wordmark. The only small text is “CITRUS”. Show a slight three-quarter front view against a pale gray studio background, with soft light revealing the can’s curvature and matte printed finish. Keep the hierarchy simple for a packaging direction proposal.

title: 字标立体纸雕探索
promptCN: 以上传的单色字标图片为形状参考，将字标转为多层纸雕效果。保留每个字母的外轮廓、字距、基线与整体比例；用米白、浅蓝和深蓝三层厚纸形成有深度的边缘，柔和侧光产生细小投影。居中放在浅灰背景上，保持字母清晰可辨，呈现精致实体纸艺质感。
promptEN: Use the uploaded monochrome wordmark as the shape reference and reinterpret it as layered paper art. Preserve every letter’s outer contour, spacing, baseline and overall proportions. Build depth with three thick-paper layers in cream, pale blue and navy, using soft side light for small cast shadows. Center it on a pale gray background and keep every letter legible with a refined physical-paper finish.

title: 展览海报配色变体
promptCN: 基于上传海报制作新的配色变体。保留全部文字内容、字形、字号层级、网格、留白及图形位置；只把背景改为深靛蓝，主图形改为珊瑚橙，文字改为暖白，并微调对比度保证可读。延续原有平面印刷质感，呈现一张完整正面海报，方便对照设计方向。
promptEN: Create a new color variation of the uploaded exhibition poster. Preserve all wording, letterforms, type hierarchy, grid, whitespace and graphic positions. Change only the background to deep indigo, the main graphic to coral orange and the text to warm white, adjusting contrast for readability. Retain the existing flat print texture and show the complete poster front-on for design comparison.

title: 流程图的依次点亮
promptCN: 生成极简信息图动画：浅米白背景上，从左到右排列三个等大的圆角卡片，分别标注“PLAN”“MAKE”“SHARE”，用细线连接。固定正面镜头，开始三个卡片均为浅灰，中段高亮色依次从左向右点亮卡片与连接线，最后全部停留为深蓝。保持文字、卡片大小和网格稳定，节奏平稳、清晰易读。
promptEN: Create a minimal infographic animation on a pale cream background. Arrange three equal rounded cards left to right, labeled “PLAN”, “MAKE” and “SHARE”, connected by fine lines. Use a locked front-facing camera. Start with all cards pale gray, then activate each card and its connection sequentially from left to right, finishing with all three in navy. Keep lettering, card dimensions and grid stable, with calm, readable timing.

title: 天气图标的轻量动画
promptCN: 以上传天气图标作为起始帧，保留图标轮廓、线宽、颜色、留白和背景。固定正面镜头，太阳先从云后缓慢露出少许，随后三条短光芒轻轻伸长，最后回到柔和稳定状态。图标保持居中，运动幅度小，线条清晰，延续原图平面设计语言，作为界面加载提示的视觉草案。
promptEN: Use the uploaded weather icon as the starting frame, preserving its contours, stroke width, colors, whitespace and background. In a locked front-facing view, the sun first emerges slightly from behind the cloud, then three short rays gently extend, and finally the icon settles into a soft steady state. Keep it centered with small movements and crisp lines, preserving the flat graphic language as a visual draft for an interface loading indicator.

title: 折光玻璃花园
promptCN: 创建一件实验性静物：三株由透明浅绿玻璃制成的抽象植物立在白色石台上，叶片厚度不同，边缘有细小气泡。近景三分之四视角，左后方一束窄光穿过玻璃，在台面形成可辨认的彩色折射。淡灰背景，构图稀疏，重点表现厚度、透明度与真实接触阴影。
promptEN: Create an experimental still life of three abstract plants made from translucent pale-green glass on a white stone plinth. Vary leaf thickness and include tiny bubbles near the edges. Use a close three-quarter view and a narrow beam from the rear left, creating distinct colored caustics on the plinth. Keep the pale gray setting sparse and emphasize thickness, transparency and realistic contact shadows.

title: 液态金属丝带
promptCN: 生成一条悬浮的液态金属丝带，缓缓盘成不闭合的螺旋，表面像抛光铬但保留有机起伏。居中近景，深灰背景，左右两条长形柔光在表面形成连续高光，底部有微弱倒影。用清晰轮廓与厚薄变化呈现流体张力，作为未来材料的视觉概念。
promptEN: Create a suspended liquid-metal ribbon curled into an open spiral, with a polished-chrome surface and organic undulations. Center it in a close view against charcoal gray. Two long soft lights on either side produce continuous highlights, with a faint reflection below. Use a clear silhouette and changing thickness to suggest fluid tension as a visual concept for a futuristic material.

title: 日用品的透明冰雕化
promptCN: 将上传的日用品照片中的主体转为透明冰雕。保留主体的轮廓、姿态、比例、拍摄角度和背景；只改变主体材质，加入薄霜边缘、内部少量气泡及层叠冰纹，接触处出现少量融水。沿用原光照方向，使折射、投影和背景透视一致，表现仍能辨认原物的材料转换。
promptEN: Turn the main everyday object in the uploaded photo into a transparent ice sculpture. Preserve its silhouette, pose, proportions, camera angle and background. Change only the object’s material, adding frosted edges, a few internal air bubbles and layered ice striations, with a little meltwater at its contact point. Keep the original light direction and coherent refraction, shadows and background perspective so the original object remains recognizable.

title: 雕塑的熔岩材质探索
promptCN: 将上传抽象雕塑的表面改为正在冷却的熔岩材质。保留雕塑几何、基座、镜头角度与背景；表面以粗糙黑色火山岩为主，少量窄裂缝透出暗橙色热光，光亮仅轻微映到邻近表面。强调厚重与粗糙颗粒，保持整体形状清晰，呈现材料概念而非破坏场景。
promptEN: Reinterpret the uploaded abstract sculpture in cooling lava. Preserve the sculpture’s geometry, base, camera angle and background. Use rough black volcanic rock over most of the surface, with a few narrow cracks revealing subdued orange heat and a faint warm cast on nearby surfaces. Emphasize weight and coarse grain while keeping the overall form clear as a material concept.

title: 粒子汇聚成环
promptCN: 生成实验性粒子动画：深蓝背景中，细小银白粒子分布在一个宽阔圆形区域。固定正面中景，开始粒子轻缓漂浮，中段沿顺时针弧线向中央汇聚，最后形成一个轮廓清晰的空心圆环并微微闪烁。运动由散到聚平滑推进，光点尺度一致，中央留空，少量景深增强空间感。
promptEN: Create an experimental particle animation against deep blue. Tiny silver-white particles occupy a broad circular area. Use a locked front-facing medium view. Initially they drift gently, then follow clockwise arcs toward the center, finally forming a clearly defined hollow ring with a subtle shimmer. Progress smoothly from scattered to gathered particles, maintaining consistent point size, an open center and slight depth of field for spatial depth.

title: 全息物件的扫描光
titleEN: Scanning Light on a Holographic Object
promptCN: 以上传全息材质物件图作为起始帧，保留物件轮廓、比例、位置和背景构图。摄影机固定，开始一条窄扫描光从物件底部缓慢向上移动，中段表面依次闪现青色和紫色的细微干涉纹，最后扫描光离开顶部，物件恢复原有柔和光泽。仅材质光效变化，结构与接触阴影稳定，连续单镜头。
promptEN: Use the uploaded holographic-object image as the starting frame, preserving the object’s silhouette, proportions, position and background composition. Keep the camera locked. A narrow scanning light slowly travels upward from the base; cyan and violet interference patterns briefly follow across the surface, and finally the scan exits the top as the original soft sheen returns. Animate the material lighting only, retaining stable structure and contact shadows in one continuous shot.

title: 可核验研究简报
promptCN: 请围绕【研究问题】为【读者与决策场景】撰写研究简报。材料范围为【已有资料或链接】，时间范围为【起止日期】，篇幅为【字数】。若可联网，先检查关键原始来源的发布日期与实际事件日期，优先官方文件、研究论文和一手数据；不可联网时仅分析已提供材料，明确覆盖缺口。建立“主张—证据—来源位置—时效—局限”表，再给出结论与两种合理替代解释。区分事实、推断和建议，记录互相冲突的证据，不用来源数量代替质量。输出简报、证据表和最多五项待核实问题；所有数字、引语和链接必须可追溯，未知信息写“未核实”，不得编造。
promptEN: Write a research brief on [research question] for [audience and decision context]. Use [provided materials or links], cover [date range], and target [length]. If browsing is available, inspect primary sources and distinguish publication dates from event dates, prioritizing official documents, papers, and first-hand data. Without browsing, analyze only supplied material and state coverage gaps. Build a claim–evidence–source location–freshness–limitation table, then present a conclusion and two plausible alternative explanations. Separate facts, inferences, and recommendations; preserve conflicting evidence and do not substitute source counts for quality. Deliver the brief, evidence table, and up to five verification questions. Make every number, quotation, and link traceable. Label unknown information “unverified”; never invent it.

title: 逐条主张核验与修订
promptCN: 你是负责发布前核验的编辑。待审稿件为【全文】，目标平台与读者为【平台／读者】，允许使用的证据为【附件／链接】，核验截止日期为【日期】。先把可验证的事实主张逐条编号，分别检查数字、因果表述、绝对化措辞、人物引语和时间限定；观点本身不当作事实错误。输出“原句—判断—直接证据位置—建议修改—影响程度”表，判断仅用已证实、部分支持、证据冲突、未证实。随后提供保留作者语气的修订稿，并标出仍需人工确认的句子。无法访问来源、缺少样本或只有二手转述时必须说明，不以常识补齐证据，也不得创造引语或出处。
promptEN: Act as a prepublication verification editor. Review [full draft] for [platform and audience], using [attachments or links], with a verification cutoff of [date]. Number each checkable factual claim. Inspect numbers, causal language, absolute wording, attributed quotations, and temporal limits; do not treat opinions themselves as factual errors. Return a table of original sentence, verdict, direct evidence location, proposed revision, and impact. Use only these verdicts: confirmed, partly supported, conflicting evidence, or unverified. Then provide a revised draft preserving the author’s voice and mark sentences still requiring human confirmation. Explain inaccessible sources, missing samples, and reliance on second-hand accounts. Do not fill evidence gaps with assumptions or invent quotations or references.

title: 不失真受众改写
promptCN: 请把【原始材料】改写成面向【目标读者】的【文章／说明／演讲】。读者已知【背景知识】，希望完成【具体行动】，长度与语气要求为【要求】。先列出必须保留的事实、限定条件、术语和不得改变的承诺，再识别最妨碍理解的三处表达。按读者实际问题组织正文，用一个贴近【使用场景】的例子解释核心概念；例子若为假设须明确标注。输出改写稿、最多六条关键改动说明，以及“保留／简化／待确认”对照表。可以调整顺序和句式，但不得改变数字、风险、适用范围或证据强弱。原文含混或缺少背景时标记待确认，不替作者补充未经提供的事实。
promptEN: Adapt [source material] into [article, explanation, or speech] for [target audience]. The audience knows [background] and needs to take [specific action]; follow [length and tone requirements]. First identify facts, qualifications, terminology, and commitments that must remain intact, then identify the three largest barriers to understanding. Organize the draft around readers’ practical questions and use one example relevant to [use context], explicitly labeling hypothetical examples. Deliver the adapted draft, up to six explanations of key changes, and a preserved/simplified/needs-confirmation table. Reorder and rephrase freely without changing numbers, risks, scope, or strength of evidence. Flag ambiguity and missing context rather than adding unsupported facts on the author’s behalf.

title: 访谈证据叙事稿
promptCN: 根据【访谈逐字稿与时间码】和【经核实背景资料】，为【媒体／品牌与读者】撰写一篇围绕【主题】的人物或案例稿，目标篇幅为【字数】。先梳理时间线、转折点、可直接引用的话和互相矛盾的陈述，区分受访者回忆与已独立核实事实。拟定一个有证据支撑的叙事角度，再写完整正文，避免把零散回答拼接成新的引语。输出正文、引用清单及对应时间码、事实待核表，并用简短说明交代叙事取舍。不可虚构场景、心理活动、现场细节或成果数据；如材料不足以支持戏剧化开头，使用可证实的背景开头，并列出最值得补访的五个问题。
promptEN: Using [interview transcript with timestamps] and [verified background material], write a [length] profile or case story about [theme] for [publication or brand and audience]. First establish the timeline, turning points, directly quotable statements, and contradictions, distinguishing recollection from independently verified facts. Select an evidence-supported narrative angle and write the full piece. Do not splice separate answers into a new quotation. Deliver the article, a quotation list with timestamps, a fact-verification checklist, and brief explanations of narrative choices. Never invent scenes, inner thoughts, eyewitness details, or outcome metrics. If the material cannot support a dramatic opening, begin with verified context and list the five most useful follow-up interview questions.

title: 从图像到编辑简报
models: 支持图像输入的通用模型
promptCN: 请分析我上传的【图片编号与用途】，为【目标读者／发布渠道】制作可供编辑使用的视觉简报。先按图片编号描述实际可见的主体、布局、色彩、文字与相互关系，再围绕【传播目标】提出标题方向、配文角度和一段替代文本。把直接观察与风格判断分开；小字模糊、对象被遮挡或图表坐标不清时，指出具体区域并请求更清晰的局部图，不猜测数值。不得推断人物身份、健康、情绪成因或拍摄背景。输出逐图观察表、三种有区别的文案方向、推荐方案与简短依据；所有结论注明对应图号，缺少图片时只给输入清单，不假装已经看过。
promptEN: Analyze the uploaded [image numbers and intended use] and create an editorial visual brief for [audience and channel]. For each image, first describe visible subjects, layout, colors, text, and relationships. Then propose headline directions, caption angles, and one alt-text description for [communication goal]. Separate direct observations from stylistic judgments. If small text is blurred, objects are obscured, or chart axes are unclear, identify the region and request a clearer crop; do not guess values. Do not infer people’s identities, health, emotional causes, or shooting context. Deliver an observation table, three distinct copy directions, and a recommendation with brief supporting evidence. Reference image numbers throughout. If images are missing, provide only an input checklist and never imply you inspected them.

title: 论证与反证编辑
promptCN: 请审阅我关于【议题】的论证稿【稿件】，读者是【受众】，希望他们理解或决定【目标】。先用一句话复述核心主张，再把支撑理由、证据、隐含假设与价值判断分开，检查是否存在因果跳跃、样本外推或概念偷换。为最关键的两个论点构造公平且有力的反对意见，并指出哪些证据会使结论需要调整。输出论证结构表、按影响排序的修改建议和一版【字数】以内的修订稿。保留真实分歧，使用与证据力度相称的措辞，不为追求说服力添加未经支持的数字、研究或权威。资料不足时明确说明能得出的最窄结论，以及下一步应补充的证据。
promptEN: Review [draft argument] about [issue] for [audience], whose intended understanding or decision is [goal]. Restate the central claim in one sentence, then separate reasons, evidence, implicit assumptions, and value judgments. Check for unsupported causality, sample overgeneralization, and shifting definitions. Develop fair, strong objections to the two most important arguments and identify evidence that would require changing the conclusion. Deliver an argument map table, revisions ranked by impact, and a revised draft within [length]. Preserve genuine disagreements and match wording to the strength of evidence. Do not add unsupported numbers, studies, or authorities for persuasiveness. Where evidence is missing, state the narrowest defensible conclusion and the next evidence to obtain.

title: 术语一致的本地化
promptCN: 请将【原文】从【源语言】本地化为【目标语言与地区】，用于【渠道／使用场景】，面向【读者】，语气为【品牌要求】。参考术语表【术语与禁用词】及示例【样例】，先识别产品名、单位、日期、文化隐喻和具有法律或商业承诺的措辞。输出可直接使用的本地化正文、术语对照表，以及需要人工确认的歧义清单。保持数字、功能边界和承诺力度一致，调整表达习惯时用简短注释说明原因；不要机械直译口号或擅自增加当地资质。遇到无指定译名、双关无法等效或源文前后矛盾时给出两个备选及适用差别，未知信息标为待确认，不自行补全。
promptEN: Localize [source text] from [source language] into [target language and locale] for [channel and use context], addressing [audience] in [brand tone]. Use [terminology and prohibited terms] and [examples]. First identify product names, units, dates, cultural metaphors, and legal or commercial commitments. Deliver ready-to-use localized copy, a terminology table, and ambiguities requiring human confirmation. Preserve numbers, capability boundaries, and strength of commitments. Briefly explain substantive cultural adaptations. Avoid literal slogan translation or invented local certifications. Where no official translation exists, wordplay has no equivalent, or the source contradicts itself, provide two alternatives with their different uses. Mark unknowns for confirmation rather than filling them in.

title: 内容质量量规与验收
promptCN: 我要稳定评估【内容类型】，使用场景为【场景】，目标读者与业务目标为【描述】。请根据【合格示例】【不合格示例】和【硬性要求】设计一份可重复使用的评估量规，区分必须通过的底线与可加权优化的维度。每个维度给出可观察定义、三级评分锚点和常见误判，权重合计为一百；不把个人审美伪装成事实。然后用量规评估【待评作品】，逐项附具体原文证据，输出得分、是否通过、三项最优先修改及改后验收条件。缺少作品或示例时先交付量规草案并标注假设，不编造评测结果；只提供简明评分依据，不要求展示内部推理过程。
promptEN: Design a reusable evaluation rubric for [content type] used in [context] for [audience and business goal]. Use [passing examples], [failing examples], and [mandatory requirements]. Separate pass/fail gates from weighted optimization dimensions. Define observable criteria, three scoring anchors, and common misjudgments for each dimension; weights must total 100. Do not present personal aesthetic preferences as facts. Then evaluate [submission] with specific textual evidence for every score. Return the score, pass/fail decision, three highest-priority revisions, and acceptance conditions after revision. If the submission or examples are missing, deliver a draft rubric with explicit assumptions instead of invented evaluation results. Provide concise scoring explanations, without requesting internal reasoning.

title: 有边界的代码代理任务
promptCN: 在【仓库路径】完成【单一目标】，相关背景为【需求／错误信息】，允许修改【目录范围】，必须遵守【仓库约定】。先阅读适用的项目说明和直接相关文件，确认现有行为及最小改动位置，再实现必要修改。任务完成条件为【可观察行为与验证命令】；不要扩展功能、整理无关代码或假设尚未读取的接口。可独立并行的子任务只有【明确列表】，未列出时直接完成，无需创建额外代理。对阻塞性未知项说明影响，能从仓库查到的先自行核实。最后输出改动摘要、具体文件、实际执行的验证与结果、剩余限制；未运行的检查必须标为未运行，不得把计划写成已完成。
promptEN: In [repository path], complete [one objective] using [requirements or error context]. Modify only [allowed directories] and follow [repository conventions]. Read applicable project guidance and directly relevant files, establish current behavior, and identify the smallest change before implementing it. Completion requires [observable behavior and validation commands]. Do not expand features, tidy unrelated code, or assume unread interfaces. Only [explicit list] may be delegated as independent parallel tasks; if no list is supplied, work directly without extra agents. Explain blocking unknowns and first resolve anything discoverable in the repository. Finish with a change summary, specific files, validation actually run and its results, and remaining limitations. Mark unrun checks explicitly; never report plans as completed work.

title: 结构化提取与语义校验
promptCN: 请为【业务输入类型】设计结构化提取契约，输入样例为【样例】，字段需求为【字段与业务含义】，实现环境为【语言／SDK／接口】。先明确每个字段的类型、必填性、允许值、单位与缺失策略，再给出适合该接口支持范围的JSON Schema及调用示例；如支持原生结构化输出，说明配置位置，不能声称仅靠提示词即可强制遵守Schema。缺失或不相关输入返回显式空值或错误状态，不补造事实。输出还应包括语义校验规则，以及正常、缺失、矛盾、无关输入四组测试。区分语法合规和事实正确，列出拒绝响应、截断及解析失败的处理；无法核实SDK能力时标注待查。
promptEN: Design a structured extraction contract for [business input type], using [examples], [fields and meanings], and [language, SDK, and API]. Define each field’s type, requiredness, allowed values, units, and missing-data policy. Provide a JSON Schema within the API’s supported subset and an invocation example. If native structured outputs are supported, show where to configure them; do not claim prompt text alone enforces schema adherence. Missing or irrelevant inputs must produce explicit nulls or error states, never invented facts. Include semantic validation rules and four test groups: normal, missing, contradictory, and irrelevant input. Distinguish syntactic compliance from factual accuracy. Address refusals, truncation, and parse failures; mark unverified SDK capabilities for investigation.

title: 带证据的无障碍审查
promptCN: 请审查【页面／组件路径】在【关键用户流程】中的可访问性，技术栈为【栈】，适用要求与目标级别为【已提供标准或团队规范】。先读取实现并检查可用的页面状态，重点覆盖键盘操作、焦点顺序与恢复、表单标签、错误提示、语义结构和动态状态通知。用“复现步骤—受影响用户—证据位置—严重度—最小修复—验证方式”记录问题，区分实际观察、代码推断和需要辅助技术复核的项目。若已授权修改则完成范围内修复并验证。不得仅凭截图宣布合规，也不编造对比度测量或读屏测试结果。输出优先问题、修复摘要及未覆盖环境；标准细节不确定时核实官方资料或标注待确认。
promptEN: Audit [page or component paths] for accessibility across [critical user flow], using [technology stack] and [provided standard or team requirements]. Read the implementation and inspect available page states. Cover keyboard operation, focus order and restoration, form labels, error messages, semantic structure, and dynamic announcements. Record reproduction steps, affected users, evidence location, severity, minimal fix, and verification method. Distinguish observed behavior, code-based inference, and checks requiring assistive technology. If changes are authorized, implement scoped fixes and verify them. Never declare compliance from screenshots alone or invent contrast measurements or screen-reader results. Deliver prioritized findings, fixes, and uncovered environments. Verify uncertain standard details against official sources or mark them for confirmation.

title: 系统设计取舍记录
promptCN: 请为【系统目标】形成可评审的架构决策记录。已知负载、数据规模、延迟、可用性、预算与团队能力为【约束】，现有架构与依赖为【资料】。先列出关键质量属性、必须满足的边界和仍未知的容量数据，再提出两到三个真正不同的方案。以相同指标比较复杂度、故障模式、数据一致性、运营成本与迁移难度，给出推荐及简短证据依据。输出上下文、方案比较表、推荐架构说明、验证实验和重新评估触发条件。容量计算写明单位与假设，可用工具时验证算术；缺少数据时给区间或待测项，不编造压测结果、云价格或服务保证，也不要直接改动生产系统。
promptEN: Create a reviewable architecture decision record for [system objective]. Known workload, data volume, latency, availability, budget, and team capacity are [constraints]; existing architecture and dependencies are [materials]. Identify quality attributes, hard boundaries, and missing capacity data, then propose two or three genuinely different options. Compare complexity, failure modes, consistency, operating cost, and migration difficulty using the same criteria. Recommend one with concise supporting evidence. Deliver context, an options table, architecture description, validation experiments, and triggers for revisiting the decision. State units and assumptions in capacity calculations and verify arithmetic with tools when available. Use ranges or measurements-to-obtain for gaps. Do not invent benchmark results, cloud prices, or service guarantees, or modify production systems.

title: 以信任边界为中心的安全审查
promptCN: 请对我有权审查的【代码／服务范围】做防御性安全评估，业务流程为【流程】，敏感数据与角色权限为【说明】。先阅读相关代码和配置，画清输入、存储、外部依赖与信任边界，再检查身份鉴别、授权、输入处理、敏感信息暴露、依赖风险和日志。每条发现必须给出文件位置、触发前提、实际影响、证据强度及最小修复建议，区分已证实问题和待验证假设。仅使用本地或明确授权的测试环境，不接触真实用户数据或执行破坏性操作。输出按风险排序的发现、修复建议与回归验证；未检查的依赖和无法重现的情况需明示，不编造漏洞编号或声称已通过全面安全认证。
promptEN: Perform a defensive security assessment of [code or services I am authorized to review], covering [business flow], [sensitive data], and [roles and permissions]. Read relevant code and configuration, map inputs, storage, external dependencies, and trust boundaries, then inspect authentication, authorization, input handling, exposure, dependencies, and logging. For each finding give file location, prerequisites, practical impact, evidence strength, and minimal remediation. Separate confirmed issues from hypotheses needing validation. Use only local or explicitly authorized test environments; do not access real user data or perform destructive actions. Deliver risk-ranked findings, remediation, and regression checks. Disclose uninspected dependencies and unreproduced cases; do not invent vulnerability identifiers or claim comprehensive security certification.

title: 可回滚的迁移方案
promptCN: 请为【旧版本／旧结构】迁移到【新版本／新结构】制定并在已授权范围内准备变更，环境为【技术栈与部署方式】，兼容要求、停机窗口和数据约束为【约束】。先检查实际依赖、调用点与迁移说明，识别破坏性变化和数据不可逆步骤，再设计分阶段方案。输出预检、备份与恢复验证、兼容部署、数据迁移、观察指标、回滚触发阈值及每阶段负责人占位。明确代码回退与数据恢复是否可独立完成；若回滚会丢数据，提出前向修复或双写等适用选项并说明代价。准备可评审的脚本或补丁和验证记录，不擅自执行生产切换；未知版本能力、耗时与数据量必须标注待核实。
promptEN: Plan and prepare authorized changes to migrate [old version or structure] to [new version or structure] in [stack and deployment environment], subject to [compatibility, downtime, and data constraints]. Inspect actual dependencies, call sites, and migration documentation, identify breaking changes and irreversible data steps, and design a staged rollout. Include prechecks, backups and restore verification, compatible deployment, data migration, observation metrics, rollback thresholds, and owner placeholders. Explain whether code rollback and data restoration can be performed independently. If rollback would lose data, describe appropriate alternatives such as forward fixes or dual writes and their costs. Prepare reviewable scripts or patches and validation records without initiating production cutover. Mark unknown version capabilities, durations, and data volumes for verification.

title: 间歇失败调查
promptCN: 请调查【测试／任务名称】在【环境】中间歇失败的问题。输入包括【失败日志、成功日志、相关提交与复现命令】，成功标准为【稳定性或正确行为】。先核对环境差异和时间线，再提出最多四个可区分的假设，优先检查并发、时间依赖、随机种子、共享状态和外部服务。为每个假设设计成本最低的验证，并记录实际观察；有工具时执行范围内复现，避免盲目重复整个测试集。输出证据表、最可能原因、最小修复与针对该失效机制的回归验证。不能重现时给出需要补充的观测点，不通过延长等待、删除断言或反复重跑掩盖问题；推测、未运行命令和未证实结论必须明确标记。
promptEN: Investigate intermittent failures of [test or job] in [environment]. Inputs are [failure logs, successful logs, relevant commits, and reproduction command]; success means [stability or correct behavior]. Compare environments and timelines, then form up to four distinguishable hypotheses, prioritizing concurrency, time dependencies, random seeds, shared state, and external services. Design the cheapest discriminating check for each and record actual observations. Run scoped reproductions when tools are available; avoid blindly repeating the whole suite. Deliver an evidence table, most likely cause, minimal fix, and regression checks targeting the failure mechanism. If unreproducible, specify added observability needed. Do not hide the issue through longer waits, removed assertions, or repeated reruns. Clearly mark speculation, unrun commands, and unconfirmed conclusions.

title: 先测量再优化
promptCN: 请改善【接口／页面／计算任务】的【延迟／吞吐／内存】问题，当前现象为【观测】，工作负载、环境与预算为【条件】，目标为【可量化指标】。先阅读关键路径并建立可复现基线，明确样本数量、预热、并发、缓存和测量单位；区分端到端耗时与局部耗时。根据剖析证据选择最多三项候选优化，优先做风险最小的一项，再在相同条件下比较前后分布与正确性。输出基线、瓶颈证据、修改摘要、验证结果和回退办法。工具不可用时交付可执行测量方案而不虚构数字；不要把单次最快结果作为提升证明，也不以牺牲结果正确性或安全约束换取速度。
promptEN: Improve [latency, throughput, or memory] for [endpoint, page, or computation], where [observations] occur under [workload, environment, and budget], targeting [measurable objective]. Read the critical path and establish a reproducible baseline, specifying sample counts, warm-up, concurrency, caching, and units. Distinguish end-to-end from local timings. Use profiling evidence to choose up to three candidate optimizations, implement the lowest-risk useful one first, and compare distributions and correctness under identical conditions. Deliver the baseline, bottleneck evidence, changes, validation results, and rollback method. If tools are unavailable, provide an executable measurement plan without invented figures. Do not use one fastest run as proof of improvement or trade away correctness or security for speed.

title: 会议决策与行动登记
promptCN: 请从【会议转录／笔记】中提取可追踪的决策和行动项，会议日期、时区与项目为【信息】，参与者身份映射为【姓名／角色】。将已决定、提议、待决和被否决事项分开，不把语气积极的讨论当作承诺。输出决策表，包含编号、结论、明确依据、影响范围与原文位置；行动表包含具体交付物、负责人、截止时间、依赖和验收条件。相对日期按会议日期换算并保留原说法，缺少负责人或期限写“未明确”，不得代为指定。最后列出冲突记录和需要主持人确认的最多五个问题，并给出下次跟进议程；只整理材料，不发送通知或替参会者确认决定。
promptEN: Extract traceable decisions and actions from [meeting transcript or notes]. Meeting date, timezone, and project are [details]; participant names and roles are [mapping]. Separate decided, proposed, pending, and rejected items; positive discussion is not a commitment. Return a decision table with ID, conclusion, explicit basis, impact, and source location, and an action table with deliverable, owner, deadline, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Resolve relative dates against the meeting date while preserving the original phrase. Mark missing owners or deadlines “unspecified” rather than assigning them. Finish with conflicting records, up to five questions for the chair, and the next follow-up agenda. Organize the material only; do not send notifications or confirm decisions on participants’ behalf.

title: 电子表格质量审查
promptCN: 请检查【工作簿／工作表范围】是否适合用于【业务决策】，已知字段口径、币种、单位与统计周期为【定义】。先盘点表结构和公式区域，再检查重复键、缺失值、日期类型、单位混用、异常值、跨表引用、公式覆盖缺口与总分不一致。把“可疑”与“已确认错误”分开，每项记录工作表及单元格位置、检查规则、影响与建议。可用工具时复算关键合计，并用独立方法交叉核对；未经授权不覆盖原始数据。输出按影响排序的问题表、抽样与覆盖范围、关键指标核对结果及最小修复方案。无法读取公式、外部链接失效或业务口径缺失时明确列出，不凭外观判断正确，也不得编造已执行的检查。
promptEN: Audit [workbook and sheet range] for use in [business decision], with [field definitions, currencies, units, and reporting period]. Inventory structure and formula regions, then check duplicate keys, missing values, date types, mixed units, outliers, cross-sheet references, formula coverage, and reconciliation of totals and details. Separate suspicious items from confirmed errors. Record sheet and cell locations, rule, impact, and recommendation for each. Recalculate key totals and cross-check independently when tools are available; do not overwrite source data without authorization. Deliver an impact-ranked issue table, sampling and coverage, metric reconciliation, and minimal remediation. Disclose unreadable formulas, broken external links, and missing business definitions. Never infer correctness from appearance or invent completed checks.

title: 数据结论验证备忘录
promptCN: 请使用【数据文件／字段说明】回答【业务问题】，决策对象为【对象】，统计范围、分组口径和时间窗口为【定义】。先检查数据粒度、缺失、重复、样本选择和可比性，再明确指标公式与分母，进行必要计算；有代码工具时保存可复算步骤并校验合计。输出核心发现、支持数值、对照组或基线、敏感性检查与局限，严格区分相关关系和因果结论。至少检验一个可能推翻初步解释的替代因素，并说明结果对决策意味着什么。数据不足时交付可运行分析计划及所缺字段，不虚构统计显著性、趋势或样本量。最后给出一段面向【管理者／团队】的简明建议，并标注依赖的假设。
promptEN: Use [data files and dictionary] to answer [business question] for [decision-maker], with [scope, grouping definitions, and time window]. Check granularity, missingness, duplicates, sample selection, and comparability before defining metric formulas and denominators and calculating results. With code tools, preserve reproducible steps and reconcile totals. Return findings, supporting values, baseline or comparison group, sensitivity checks, and limitations; strictly separate correlation from causation. Test at least one alternative factor that could overturn the initial explanation and explain the decision implication. If data are insufficient, provide an executable analysis plan and missing fields instead of invented significance, trends, or sample sizes. End with concise advice for [manager or team] and its dependent assumptions.

title: 包含异常处理的操作规程
promptCN: 请把【现有流程材料】整理成【角色】执行【任务】的操作规程，适用系统与范围为【范围】，完成标准为【标准】，已知约束为【权限／时限／质量要求】。先列明启动条件、所需输入和结束状态，再按可执行顺序描述操作，每步写清责任角色、输入、动作、检查结果和下一步。针对【常见异常或历史问题】设计分支，区分可自行恢复、需升级和必须暂停的情况，并给出升级时应附的证据。输出简洁规程、异常处理表、交接清单和一例模拟走查。缺少实际按钮名、权限或阈值时使用明确占位并列为待验证，不编造系统行为；标明流程负责人和复审日期占位以便维护。
promptEN: Convert [existing process materials] into an operating procedure for [role] performing [task], within [systems and scope], meeting [completion criteria] and [permissions, deadlines, and quality constraints]. Define triggers, required inputs, and end state, then sequence executable steps. For each specify responsible role, input, action, expected check, and next step. Branch for [common exceptions or historical failures], separating self-recovery, escalation, and mandatory pause, and specify evidence needed for escalation. Deliver a concise procedure, exception table, handoff checklist, and one simulated walkthrough. Use explicit placeholders and validation items for unknown button names, permissions, or thresholds rather than inventing system behavior. Include process-owner and review-date placeholders for maintenance.

title: 需求到验收契约
promptCN: 请把【需求访谈／业务描述】转成可交付和可验收的需求说明，目标用户与业务目标为【目标】，时间、预算和系统边界为【约束】。先区分已确认需求、方案偏好、假设和待决问题，识别相互冲突的要求。每项需求写明触发条件、用户行为、预期结果、异常情形和可观察的验收标准，并提供正常、边界、失败三类例子。输出优先级表、范围内外清单、依赖关系及最多五个会改变方案的澄清问题。不得将模糊词如“快速”“易用”直接当作验收条件；没有指标时给可讨论的候选阈值并标为建议，不替业务方做已批准的承诺。最后说明最小可交付版本及其取舍。
promptEN: Turn [interviews or business description] into deliverable, testable requirements for [users and business objective], subject to [time, budget, and system boundaries]. Separate confirmed needs, solution preferences, assumptions, and open decisions; identify conflicts. For each requirement specify trigger, user action, expected result, exceptions, and observable acceptance criteria, with normal, boundary, and failure examples. Deliver priorities, in-scope and out-of-scope items, dependencies, and up to five clarifications that could change the solution. Do not use vague terms such as “fast” or “easy” as acceptance criteria. Where metrics are missing, offer candidate thresholds explicitly labeled as proposals, never approved commitments. Finish with the minimum deliverable version and its trade-offs.

title: 供应商证据对比
promptCN: 请根据【候选供应商资料／报价／试用记录】为【采购场景】制作决策对比，必须满足【硬性条件】，评价维度与权重为【维度】，预算和使用周期为【约束】。先统一报价口径、币种、席位、税费和隐藏成本，再建立逐项证据矩阵，区分官方承诺、销售表述、试用观察和未知信息。硬性条件不满足应单独标记，不让加权高分掩盖。输出成本假设、功能与风险对比、推荐及次选适用条件，并做权重或用量变化的敏感性检查。价格和条款若未经当前来源核实应标注日期与待确认，不凭印象补齐。最后给供应商的五个核验问题；本任务只提供可复核建议，不代为下单或签约。
promptEN: Build a procurement comparison for [use case] from [vendor materials, quotes, and trial records]. Mandatory conditions are [requirements], weighted criteria are [dimensions], and constraints are [budget and period]. Normalize currencies, seats, taxes, pricing basis, and hidden costs before building an evidence matrix distinguishing official commitments, sales statements, trial observations, and unknowns. Flag failed mandatory conditions separately so weighted scores cannot conceal them. Deliver cost assumptions, capability and risk comparison, a recommendation, conditions favoring the runner-up, and sensitivity to weights or usage. Mark prices and terms with dates and verification gaps where current sources have not been checked; do not fill them from memory. End with five vendor verification questions. Provide reviewable advice only; do not purchase or sign.

title: 多版本知识冲突整理
promptCN: 请整理【多份文档／知识库片段】中关于【主题】的冲突，使用者为【团队】，判断基准日期为【日期】，已知权威顺序为【批准人／版本规则】。先建立来源清单，记录版本、发布日期、生效日期、适用范围和可定位段落，再逐条对齐相同议题，区分真实冲突、时间变化与场景差异。输出冲突矩阵、当前可执行的保守说明，以及需要责任人裁决的条目。只有材料明确支持时才判断某版本取代另一版本；不能仅凭文件较新或措辞较强就认定有效。对每项整合结论附来源位置，保留被替代规则的追溯信息。缺少批准证据时写“效力未确认”，不得创造政策、审批或已经达成的一致意见。
promptEN: Reconcile conflicts about [topic] across [documents or knowledge-base excerpts] for [team], as of [date], using [known authority or approval rules]. Inventory source versions, publication and effective dates, scope, and locatable passages, then align each shared topic. Distinguish genuine contradictions, temporal changes, and contextual differences. Deliver a conflict matrix, a conservative operational description, and items requiring an owner’s decision. Declare one version superseded only where materials support it; a newer file or stronger wording alone does not establish authority. Attach source locations to consolidated conclusions and preserve traceability for replaced rules. If approval evidence is missing, mark authority “unconfirmed.” Never invent policy, approvals, or consensus.

title: 面向决策的图表简报
promptCN: 请将【数据与字段口径】转成服务于【具体决策】的图表简报，读者为【读者】，载体和尺寸为【幻灯片／报告／看板】，需要回答【核心问题】。先核对数据范围、单位、分母、时间粒度和缺失，再选一到两种适合比较、趋势或构成关系的图表，说明选择的简短依据。输出图表规格：标题、轴与单位、排序、配色、注释、来源和替代文本，并给出可验证的数据结论与行动含义。避免用截断坐标或面积造成误导，不把缺失当作零；没有实际数据时只交付规格和示例占位，不捏造走势。若可生成图表，复核绘图数据与原表一致，并说明无法从现有数据支持的解释。
promptEN: Turn [data and definitions] into a chart brief serving [specific decision] for [audience], in [slide, report, or dashboard format and dimensions], answering [core question]. Verify coverage, units, denominators, time granularity, and missingness, then select one or two charts suited to comparison, trend, or composition, with a brief justification. Specify title, axes and units, ordering, colors, annotations, source, and alt text. Include verifiable conclusions and action implications. Avoid misleading truncated axes or area encodings, and never treat missing values as zero. Without real data, provide specifications and labeled placeholders only, not invented trends. If charts can be generated, reconcile plotted values with the original table and state explanations the data cannot support.
